data.description: A source of considerable wealth for the few alchemists talented enough to distill them, these potions are capable of adding decades to the lifespan of those who can afford the price of the rare and expensive ingredients they require.  They are however not able to prolong a life indefinitely beyond its natural years, and you will need to find other means to achieve immortality, if that is your goal.
This is a potion of wicked quick hands.  It will increase your dexterity for 50 minutes.
This is a potion of terrible strength.  It will increase your strength for 50 minutes.
This is a potion of hare's leap.  It allows you to jump afar from danger.
This is a transmutation potion that will bring your best attributes to the forefront.

In a wooden bowl, Faewild and Dreamdross are mixed together along with ground-up leaves.  The mixture has fae and human blood added to it and parts from the plant fae and then all mixed again until it's a uniform blend.  The resulting mixture will eventually dissolve into a deep green liquid.

Heat Faewild and Dreamdross over a roaring fire and the mix in the ashes until you have a thick paste.  That paste is mixed with parts taken from the Fair Folk and united with a dollop of fae, and human blood.  The resulting mixture will eventually dissolve into a scarlet liquid that shines with its own light.

While looking in a mirror, Faewild and Dreamdross are ground to dust.  That dust is mixed with parts taken from the Fair Folk and united with a dollop of fae, and human blood.  The resulting mixture will eventually dissolve into what almost looks like liquid porcelain.

The 9×21mm Gyurza (Гюрза, Russian for 'blunt-nosed viper') round is a Russian handgun round designed to defeat body armor that was developed by TsNIITochMash for its SR-1 Vektor semi-automatic pistol and SR-2 Veresk submachine gun.  The 7N29 AP loading fires a 6.7 g (103 gr) bullet at 410 m/s (1,300 ft/s) with 560 J (410 ft⋅lb) of muzzle energy, and will reportedly penetrate two 1.2 mm titanium plates, plus 30 layers of Kevlar, at 50 m (160 ft).  The disadvantage of the rounds is that high impact velocities are needed for them to work effectively, so the bullets are relatively light to maximize their muzzle velocity.  This means they will lose velocity relatively quickly, limiting their effective range.

Your skin has hardened into a granite like covering.
Your eyes now reflect your mood in the colors of stone.  You are also immune to the glare of the sun.
Your stone-like skin means your hands hit like hammers, and can be used like hammers as well.

A thin layer of bark covers your body.
Your eyes now reflect the seasons: green, yellow, red, orange, or brown.  You are also immune to the glare of the sun.
Your skin is covered in thick, woody thorns.
Your hands and fingers have transformed into jagged wooden claws.
Your skin has magical flames flaring out of it on occasion.  You can operate in warmer climates than normal humans but begin to take damage from getting wet.
Your skin exudes magickal flames constantly, you can operate in almost any heat now without danger but rain may be a lethal threat.
Your eyes now reflect your mood, the warm red of a campfire or the searing heat of an incendiary weapon.  Glare no longer affects you.
Heat from your hands.  You may cook with it at will.
Your skin has become vaguely gelatinous.  Provides some extra bash defense and immunity to wet effects.
Your skin is completely replaced by magickal water.  You have become immune to acid effects.

Your eyes now reflect your mood in the colors of the deep waters.  From an aquamarine blue when you are pleased to the pitch black of the depths when you are angry or sad.  You are also immune to the glare of the sun and can see under water.
Your skin is capable of .

You have an organ inside of your body that grows a material you can create improved versions of your body parts with.  You must combine it with components taken from monsters with abilities you wish to gain and magickal essence.

Your skin is clearly separate from the air around you but has become its own weather system.  If someone reaches out and touches you, they will clearly feel you but you look like someone might reach right through you.
Your skin is a roiling storm.  Your flexibility is greatly increased, your ability to ignore temperatures hot and cold have greatly increased but your ability to carry objects has been reduced.
Your eyes now reflect your mood in different weather patterns.  Clear blue skies when you are pleased and storms when you are mad.  You are also immune to the glare of the sun.
You can now exist as your own source of oxygen.  Anywhere that you would be impacted by a lack of oxygen should no longer trouble you.
Your skin has smoothed and all your prior blemishes have faded away.  This somewhat reduces wet effects and leads to a more durable yet harder to heal body.
Your skin has become latex like.  While it provides additional protection and attractiveness it also heals at a much slower rate.
Your eyes now stare out at the world, impassive and blank like the eyes of a doll.  You are also immune to the glare of the sun.
The spirits of past artisans guide your hands.
With but a touch, you can override the circuits of electronics and grant yourself access.
You can vaguely sense this organ… somewhere in your body.
Breathing is now something you decide to do, rather than a biological necessity.
You have massive claws on your end of your furry fingers.
A mouth full of vicious sharp teeth, almost twice as large as a wolf's.
Thick fur-like hair covering your entire body.
You have a majestic crown of antlers.

A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.  You can barely make out the words 'Blood treatment' followed by a list of ingredients.

I'm sorry that I won't be there to greet you when you awaken into sentience my offspring, but this world is dying and I must take the roads back home before they darken and grow cold.  Even if I were here you would likely find my company to be short lived as the tradition of our people is to witness the waking and greet our offspring then leave them to explore the world on their own.  However, I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  I hope that you survive long enough to become what I hoped for you to be and that you are able to find one of the trodden paths from this place into the borderlands and from there deeper into Fae where you will hopefully find me.  All of my hopes and dreams ride with you.

My dearest child, you are awaking into a cold dying world alone and without parents.  Honestly, this is for the best, for I was brought to life amongst the mortals of this realm and the parenting I would be able to pass on to you is entirely tragic.  I will spare you from that fate.  However, I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  I hope that you survive long enough to become what I hoped for you to be and that you are able to find one of the trodden paths from this place into the borderlands and from there deeper into Fae where you will hopefully find me.  All of my hopes and dreams ride with you.

If you are reading this you have woken up to sentience as I planned.  My timing however was not great in that I've been forced to leave before showing you the hunting ground that I've brought you into existence in.  How I envy the experience you will have rampaging through the ashes of the old world.  There is significant danger in this world and in time you will be one of the most dangerous beings in it.  However, since that time is not yet I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  I hope that you rise to the top of this crush of predators I've been forced to abandon you among.  Good luck and good hunting.

Spawn of my intentions, I address you from across space and time on today the day of your hatching.  As is the custom of our people you have been left in an uncivilized and barbaric place.  You must make your way back to us to become one of us.  For now you will take a name like those of the dead civilization we've deposited you in.  While you must develop on your own and find your way back to us, I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you, be sure to kill it first.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  The depths will tremble one day in your wake and upon that day you will know how to find us.  If you fail we shall never know your name, like all the other lost children.

My beloved child, the Cataclysm struck at this world at a crucial time in your development and we were forced to leave you behind to be born alone or to mercy kill the life you were becoming.  When that was the choice upon us it felt like no choice at all.  If that was the kinder fate, I am sorry but my hopes to meet you one day were too strong.  I am shamed that our clan will be unable to provide you shade and company but, I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  I hope that you survive long enough to become what I hoped for you to be and that you are able to find one of the trodden paths from this place into the borderlands and from there deeper into Fae where you will hopefully find me.  All of my hopes and dreams ride with you.

Brethren of soil and stone.  How our tribe longed to see you stretch forth from the forming pit like so many others before you.  It is shame that will take many generations of our people to wash away that we were unable to stay to bring you with us.  However, I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  I hope that you survive long enough to become what I hoped for you to be and that you are able to find one of the trodden paths from this place into the borderlands and from there deeper into Fae where you will hopefully find me.  We await you joining our chorus in the deep caves of Fae, once you find your way here.

data.description:
The notes you have taken about the cryptid you're hunting.
Also known as the mongolian death worm, the Olgoi-khorkhoi is a massive acid-spewing burrowing worm.  Finding acid-resistant gear will prove useful to survive the encounter.  According to most of the credible stories you've read, the lethal poison covering its skin is nothing but exaggerations.

data.description:
The notes you have taken about the cryptid you're hunting.
The man of the Nineteenth Hour is peaceful for most of the day but becomes incredibly violent against those who are still awake when he enters his active phase.  Some stories tell that his presence shields those who are sleeping against everything that could disturb their sleep.
This handwritten book contains the detailed yet disorganized notes of a vampire who found how to consume other vampires for power.  Reading it might tell you how to do it, if it is what you want.
data.//: As it is a unique item acquired in violent circumstances, I made it fireproof so the player can use fire without fearing the lost of this item.

name.str_pl: copies of Report: LAUGHING DANCER metallurgy

data.description: A series of documents discussing the properties of the armor and weapons used by a group or organization only referred to as "LAUGHING DANCER".  Some of these described specifications don't seem physically possible.
A magazine for occult investigators.  These types of magazines proliferated in the decade prior to the Cataclysm.

A tabloid paper with a rather unusually out-of-this-world articles even for tabloids' standard, ranging from something like an article about morticians selling the deceased's 'dreams' to the government to a sensational headline about a half-bat half-human boy causing 40-car pileup in the highway while driving away from police pursuit.  While most thought of The Noon as an amusing but otherwise mostly fake news paper in the past, the Cataclysm might bring the articles' presumably fake facts to light.

name.str: The Holmesian Guide to Magickal Practice
name.str_pl: copies of The Holmesian Guide to Magickal Practice

data.description: It's big and heavy, but full of great information about esoteric investigations.

name.str_pl: copies of Scraggy-Boo and the Mystery Crew

data.description: A guide for teens interested in pursuing occult knowledge.  Readers often speak of encountering a guide in their dreams of a Russian Sheepdog, who introduces himself as Scraggy-Boo.

name.str_pl: copies of Escaping the Black Iron Prison

data.description: A hardbound book detailing numerous rituals and thought modifications in order to teach its readers how to break the shackles of mundanity.

This book always feels like it shouldn't be where it is.  Its texts are incoherent and illogical, but they promise to help you understand something.  Reading a few words from its pages is enough to give you a headache.
data.//: When possible, reading it should be literally painful.  Not much, but enough for the player to notice.
The writer wrote this book as fast as they could, for they knew the Lies would soon kill them for doing so.
data.description:
A haphazardly-written book filled with ramblings about something it calls "the Lies".  You feel threatened by this book, uneasy at the thought of having it on your person, but parsing its texts could give you insight on how things truly are.
Only the first third of the pages are filled with text, and the last written page is splattered in red.
data.//2: When possible, this should be a book.  There is currently no way to hook EOCs to reading a certain book.

data.description: These organs came from a beast from the nether.

A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing animal from a specific region of the Nether.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.
Freshly butchered meat from a fae beast.  You could eat it raw, but cooking it is better.
This is a tiny scrap of edible meat from a fae beast.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.
Blood, from a specific part of the Nether.  Disgusting!
This is a chunk of freshly cooked fae meat.  It's filling and nutritious, but unseasoned and a bit bland.
Tasty meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.
The stomach of an omnivorous creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
The four stomachs of a grazing creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
The stomach of a herbivore.  It is surprisingly durable.
The stomach of an carnivorous creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
The stomach of a small carnivorous creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
The stomach of a small omnivorous creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
The stomach of a small herbivore.  It is surprisingly durable.
The two stomachs of a giant ant.  One stomach is for digestion and one stomach is for storing food for the colony.
Blood extracted from a vampire.  Drinking it feels like a bad idea but there might be other ways to use it.
An empty casing from a 9x21mm round.

This seed might be more accurately compared to a bulb, because like a bulb you dug it out of the home it had made and chopped off its extremities and are now preparing to plant it in a new location; only, in this instance the hole was dug into the chest of a dead vampire minion and the new location is nestled against the still-beating heart of a patient.

What reason could anyone have making a bionic power generator that runs off the blood of vampires?  After some thought, one option that occurs to you would be the possibility that by limiting the fuel options, a vampire is also limiting the opportunities for a rogue minion to use its bionics against its master.
A jar-like container that includes a set of vocal cords with a large hood at the top of them and rootlike tendrils at the base connecting to a microchip.
A jar-like container that includes a set of oversized and reinforced vocal cords with a large hood at the top of them and rootlike tendrils at the base connecting to a microchip.
A syringe that extends out into two tubes that snake up through the nostrils and down to the lungs in order to get the spores deep into their new home, where they can best spread through the body.
A brown jumpsuit with OA written in big yellow block letters on the back.

variants.description: A brown jumpsuit with OA written in big yellow block letters on the back.
A black jumpsuit with white symbol "υ" on the back.
A black jumpsuit with white symbol "ϴ" on the back.
A black jumpsuit with white symbol "ν" on the back.
A black jumpsuit with white symbol "τ" on the back.

data.description: A short-sleeved cotton tee featuring a uniquely odd design that sets it apart from any you've seen before.

name.str: Seven Faceless Voids for Seven Brothers t-shirt
name.str_pl: Seven Faceless Voids for Seven Brothers t-shirts

variants.description: A pink t-shirt with seven ominous figures in bridal wear facing towards seven identical men.  There are tears running down from the eyes of the men.
A shirt that says Sawzall the Musical in bold letters, over a giant Sawzall tool.
This t-shirt displays a picture of a man standing behind a go table, the text is using an unfamiliar alphabet.  His features seem subtly off.
A short-sleeved cotton shirt with the logo of a Tachli team printed on its front and back.  It looks like it might be a violent sport.
A short-sleeved cotton shirt with the logo of a rollerball team, whatever that is, printed on its front and back.
This t-shirt displays a purple sun rising over a town that looks like it came out of a Doctor Seuss book.

A short-sleeved cotton shirt with a globe at the bottom with a C above the globe with an S to the left and A to the right.  The background is like a flag with the top left being the corner of a black triangle and the bottom right is a red triangle.  They meet in the middle with the globe.

data.description: A simple garment made of gossamer.  It's very light, and the fabric shimmers in a rainbow of colors in the sunlight.
A simple, sleeveless garment made of gossamer.  It's very light, and the fabric shimmers in a rainbow of colors in the sunlight.
A thick overshirt of gossamer, shimmering in a rainbow of colors.  This would have made you the king of the Renn Faire.
A gossamer dress, shimmering in a mix of rainbow colors.
A full-length gossamer gown, like a waterfall of coruscating light.
A gossamer cloak meant to be thrown over your body.  It looks like ripples of multicolored light when worn.
A thin gossamer jacket.  Despite its lack of heft, its surprisingly warm.
A flowing gossamer robe, like a waterfall of light.  There are a surprising amount of pockets cunningly hidden in the iridescent folds.
A pair of gossamer gloves.
A gossamer covering for your loins, for when you want to feel like you're wearing moonbeams.
A pair of gossamer pants with two pockets.  They shimmer opalescently.

name.//~: Hose here refers to the Medieval clothing.

data.description: A pair of tight-fitting gossamer pants with no pockets.  They would have been the absolute height of fashion five hundred years ago.
A loose gossamer skirt, like a waterfall of light.
A long gossamer skirt that shimmers like a woven rainbow.  It's warmer and more fashionable than a shorter gossamer skirt.
Gossamer socks.  Whether your shoes are made of leather or canvas or moonlight or nightmares, they'll keep your feet from rubbing in them.
A pair of gossamer stockings that shimmer in a rainbow of muted colors.
Soft indoor shoes, suitable for wearing whie drinking liquid light from goblets of unmelting ice and dancing the night away.
data.//: Very low encumbrance because these are medieval indoor shoes, not fuzzy bath slippers

data.description: A heavy cloak made of living leaves with long twigs and branches connecting them, meant to be thrown over your body.
A five-liter ingot of solid cold iron.

A classic medieval sword, just the right size to use one-handed.

Made with cold iron and lacking a proper grip, this is better than the sticks you swung around as a kid, but you know you can do better.
A medieval hammer with a spike on one end, made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.
A huge cold iron axe designed for early warfare.  Though intended for use as a weapon, it can also be pressed into service as a rather clumsy woodcutting tool.
A medieval dagger forged from cold iron.  It is not the sharpest tool in the shed, but it is certainly one of the largest.

description.str: Somehow you got a hold of the platonic goblin fruit, the one fruit to rule them all.  It's a bug if you have this, but the lords of the Bright Lands will surely pay a high price for it.

data.description: Some sort of fruit sealed in a thick shell.  The shell is rigid but seems surprisingly brittle; you could easily peel it open to see what's inside with your bare hands.
This round goblin fruit is reddish-orange with a waxy texture.  It smells sweet with a hint of petrichor.
This oblong goblin fruit shimmers slightly in a rainbow of colors.  It smells like a mix of peach and freshly-baked bread.
This round goblin fruit looks like a metal sculpture but has the yielding texture of a peach.  It smells like the tang in the air before a storm.
This long, thin goblin fruit is a subdued green color but has a smell that burns your nostrils.
This round goblin fruit is a bluish color changing to red at the ends.  It smells like a freshly-roasted hunk of meat.
This round goblin fruit has a thick red rind with a leaf still attached to the stem.  The leaf seems to move occasionally even when there is no wind.
This dark purple goblin fruit has an overpowering minty smell.  The smell even escapes sealed containers.
This pale blue goblin fruit is a cube, and the edges are fine enough to leave a line in your thumb when you press on them.  It smells incredibly sour.
This sharply-curved goblin fruit is an off-white color turning red toward the ends.  It smells like the alley outside a club.

This large goblin fruit is such a deep black color you can't actually tell exactly what shape it is.  It's roundish, but when you hold it, it seems more like you're holding a hole in the fabric of the world.  It smells like an apple.
This yellow-green goblin fruit is shaped like a donut, with six reddish stems spaced equidistantly around its circumference.  You can't imagine what the plant that grew this one looks like.

name.//~: Dolm is a fictional color from the 1920 book "A Voyage to Arcturus" that's a mix of infrared and blue.

data.description: This teardrop-shaped goblin fruit hurts to look at.  Sometimes it's a dark blue, sometimes it's a feverish red, and sometimes it's a mix of the two that you would previously have sworn could not exist.  It smells faintly peppery with a hint of lemon.
This dark-colored goblin fruit is covered in spikes like a pineapple.  Unlike a pineapple, the spikes are yielding and seem part of the fruit, not a rind.  It smells of freshly-cut grass.
A dark red goblin fruit with a heavy iron smell.  It feels warm to the touch.

This goblin fruit looks like a globe of water with seeds and a stem suspended within it.  Despite that, it feels like kiwi, with a slight fuzz and no moisture left on your fingers when you touch it.  It smells like roses.
This goblin fruit looks like a pear and feels like a pear and smells exactly like a pear.  You have no idea how it tastes because the instant you put your tongue to it, your entire mouth goes numb.

This large, curved goblin fruit is a dark blue color and feels like it's already on the verge of rotting.  It takes very little pressure for your fingers to bruise the skin and the flesh inside flakes off when you touch it.  It smells like sun-ripened strawberries.
This greenish-white goblin fruit is shaped like a star in a much more literal way than a starfruit.  It's almost like if a starfish was an apple.  It smells like freshly-laundered clothing.
This greyish goblin fruit is shaped like a pear, if pears had scales like a pinecone.  There is a pulpy meat underneath the scales.

This round blue goblin fruit glows bright enough to read by.  The light flickers like firelight, even when the fruit is simply placed on the table.  It smells like pine needles soaked in strong alcohol.
This small brown goblin fruit constantly forms bubbles that erupt from its skin.  Despite that, its surface remains smooth at all times.  It has a subtle, sugary smell.

This goblin fruit is hard to perceive.  You think it's black, you believe it's small and you're certain it's near you, but all its other details slip from your memory the instant you stop looking at this fruit.
This green goblin fruit is much heavier than it should be.  Its scent is heavy, pressing down your nose and throat as you smell it.
This sky blue fruit slows the thoughts racing in your mind a little as you stare at it, making you feel sightly more calm until you put it away.
This sinewy, beak-shaped fruit produces a faint melody.  This melody grows a little louder when you bring the fruit next to your mouth.
You can see your reflection in the mirror-like surface of this fruit.  This reflection of you seems angrier, closer to a feral human than to your own image.
The many colors of this oblong fruit shift to mimic what's behind it, trying to imitate other things with the best of its ability.
This fruit wrapped in barbed vines fills you with bitterness as you hold it.  It slightly resists inertia as you move it, as if it moved through molasses.
This yellow half-liquid fruit is hard to hold, as it actively tries to escape your grasp.  You hope it won't try to escape your innards after you eat it.
data.//: When possible, this fruit should take longer to eat, as it literally opposes your attempts to eat it.

data.description: This translucent fruit is filled with a network of tubes not unlike veins and arteries.  Judging by the way its brown surface turns blue when bruised, it probably contains a fluid similar to blood.
This fruit shines a light bright enough to be painful to look at.  From the little you can see, it appears to be a purple ovoid fruit.
This spiraled fruit ceaselessly spins on itself.  No matter how tight your grasp, you cannot stop its spinning.
This fruit pulses at regular intervals like a beating heart.  As you hold it its rhythm changes, mimicking your own heart.

You understand everything about this pale green fruit.  You know that it will taste like an apple and you know that it will have the inner structure of a kiwi, the texture of a durian, the smell of a dragon fruit and the colors of an orange.  you also know that eating it will help you understand anything you could try to learn for a few hours.

This dark red half-liquid fruit fills you with dread and sadness as it endlessly tries to split but fails to do so.  You sense that it wants you to eat it, but you're not sure if it would be worth it.
data.//: The idea is that this fruit needs to feed on happiness to create other goblin fruits and it can't do that unless you eat it, with predictable results on your own happiness.

data.description: This fruit is closer to an art project than to a fruit.  Numerous stitches hold together red-tinted parts of many different fruits so tightly it acts as a single, consistent whole.
This fruit has a perfectly unblemished surface that cannot be tarnished or dirtied, no matter what happens to it.
This gray dented fruit numbs your fingers as you hold it and its smell numbs your nose the same way.
This fruit is similar to a sphere of smoke.  Faint sounds come from this fruit.  They almost sound like whispers.
This rectangle fruit smells of lavender and has a mushy texture.  Its colors grow more vibrant for a second when you blink.

This spherical fruit is made of smaller versions of itself, which are also made of smaller versions of themselves.  Should you have a microscope, you could look at the fractal as it becomes smaller and smaller.
Reeking of glass cleaner, this disk-shaped fruit sticks to anything it touches.  Despite this, you have no issue removing any dust sticking to it.
This capsule-shaped goblin fruit behaves as a pressurized tank when you press its surface with your finger.  Fortunately, it doesn't appear to be able to explode if pierced or bitten.
This fruit is nothing more than a thin layer of fruit filled with air.  It has a heady aroma that makes you a little lightheaded.

This fruit is the most boring thing you've ever seen.  Everything about it is boring: its drab dark brown color, its smell, its lack of feature, even its taste is boring.  It's not a good fruit.  It's not a bad fruit.  It's just boring.
This fruit is always covered in fresh mud.  You try to wipe it away, but it always come back.
This fruit has the shape of a hollow cylinder.  It has a notable smell of freshly-upturned earth.
This fruit reminds you of a small bowling ball.  You can hear it as it tries to convince you to not eat it.  It won't succeed, right?
This spherical fruit bears many spines, yet all of of them are dulled.  It smells faintly of cinnamon and aftershave.
This pale fruit is surrounded by small lines of wind revolving around it.  The lines grow thicker the further the fruit is from the ground.
This fruit is easily mistakable for a fist-sized sapphire.  Its color, rigidity and facets bring to mind a gemstone, unlike its green stem.
This fruit shaped akin to a chunk torn from a beehive is warm, but becomes cold as long as anyone is looking at it.  It has a strong odor, between maple and oak, but only when unobserved.
This blue tear-shaped fruit drips with water.  You try to collect it, but it fades away before touching the container.
This fruit what a kiwi would be if kiwi had decimeter-long beige fur.  It smells of steel and lilies.
This gray fruit is hard to pierce, as it reshapes itself to close any hole you make in it.  Ironically, the fruit keeps tearing its surface apart, making its reshaping a sisyphean task.
This fruit looks like a crystal ball filled with clouds.  When you look into it, you see fragments of your most intense dreams.
Alchemically altered aspirin.  Take to relieve pain and injury.
DOES YOUR PARTNER FIND YOUR LACK OF SEXUAL POTENCY PATHETIC?!??!  SMASH YOUR BEDROOM LIKE A WILD ANIMAL ALL NIGHT LONG!!!  -ingredients not confirmed with the FDA.

use_action.activation_message: You take the %s.  Your skin feels like it is vibrating.

data.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.
data.//: Not commercially traded, in case there was any question.

data.description: A small salads worth of hawthorn petals.
Dense clusters of edible red berries grow enormously during autumn, but try not to eat the seeds as they contain cyanide.  Too tart to be very enjoyable they are often used in jams and jellies.

Figs are a unique fruit resembling a teardrop.  They're about the size of your thumb, filled with hundreds of tiny seeds, and have an edible purple or green peel.  The flesh of the fruit is pink and has a mild, sweet taste.  The scientific name for the fig is Ficus carica.

data.//: magical poisons, 'death' and 'bio' related
data.description: A clump of off white roots in the shape of a humanoid body.  It feels strange to the touch, almost alive.

A pin-shaped piece of steel.  It can be used to construct various things with a hammer.  Forged from dreamdross, which makes it much lighter.  They do curse and scream at you in an eldritch tongue while you hammer them in and sometimes refuse to be used in specific purposes.

description.str: "Wyld Candy, our flavors span the possible" is emblazoned proudly upon this shiny colorful wrapper.

data.description: A large moon tear canteen.  It radiates the cold of the grave and smells strongly of blood.  Any blood stored inside is protected from spoilage by some kind of fae enchantment.

A slim and lightweight insulated moon tear bladder worn on the back or within a hydration pouch in a backpack.  Perfect for the renfield on the go.  It has a large pocket and a capped mouth for filling with blood, with a hose that allows the wearer to drink hands-free.  Any blood stored inside is protected from spoilage by some kind of fae enchantment.

data.name: broken sniper bot
data.description: A broken sniper bot.  Total scrap, but some stuff is still useful.

data.name: broken shotgun bot
data.description: A broken shotgun bot.  Total scrap, but some stuff is still useful.

data.name: broken cutthroater
data.description: A broken cutthroater.  Total scrap, but some stuff is still useful.
A broken Exodii Jotunn walker.  Still looks incredibly intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, due to the sheer size, mass, and protruding weapons.  Could be gutted for parts.
The automaton is now much more broken than it was before.  It resembles a pile of random parts and its internals are fried beyond salvage but could be gutted for materials.

data.//: Changeling corpses.
data.description: The dead body of a changeling.  There are multiple bites across the body and numerous scratches.  It looks like blood loss might have brought them down.

snippet_category.text: The dead body of a changeling.  There are multiple bites across the body and numerous scratches.  It looks like blood loss might have brought them down.
Extreme burns cover the body of this changeling.  In multiple locations the charring goes all the way to the bone.
Several ballistic wounds seem to have brought down this changeling.  It probably happened elsewhere and they escaped to here.
This lifeless body is covered in a rime of frost, that seems resistant to the prevailing weather.
This changeling seems to have gotten themselves impaled upon an unhealthy number of large thorns.  What kind of plant could do this?
This changeling corpse has a belly wound that appears to be caused by a sword and is also missing its hand.

data.description: Your body, lying on the ground while your spirit walks free.  Hopefully nothing happens to it while you're gone.

name.str: dreamforged bed of restful repose, folded for travel
name.str_pl: dreamforged beds of restful repose, folded for travel

data.description: A large object folded up into a box for itself, the size of a keyboard.
A shimmering silvery dust.  Narcotic with the street name of Faewild.  Causes the user to see colors not normally visible to the naked human eye.

use_action.activation_message: You rub the glittering dust into your gums.

data.description: A drug that became popular over the last few years before the Cataclysm.  It appears to be exactly as its street name, a dark purple lotus blossom.  It's known to be a strong painkiller while also causing vivid hallucinations.

use_action.activation_message: You eat the purple lotus blossom.

data.description: Mixed candies purporting to come from 'Fair Folk Industries' these candies appear in areas of the country thought to have significant crossover events.  It remains unknown whether these candies are produced by a company from here taking advantage of a thin place or if they came from somewhere else.

This homemade blood treatment purports to reduce the cravings brought on by vampirism and if applied often and early to even reverse some stages of the disease.  But vampires surely can't be real, can they?

data.name: cthonic poultice
data.description: A poultice made from the elements of the earth.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were made of stone.

data.name: verdant poultice
data.description: A poultice made from plant life.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were grown from plants.

data.name: cerulean poultice
data.description: A poultice made from the elements of the sea.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were liquid as well.
A devotion to the powers of fire.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were born of the flames.
A paste made from paint and glue.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were made in man's image.
A concoction made from honey and bread.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were born of air and darkness.

description.str: Converting

data.description: Vampire blood mixed with blood none would consume and different toxic substances.  The hostile environment is already driving the vampire blood to devour itself.  It will be ready to consume in a few days.

use_action.msg: The vampire blood has completely devoured itself, leaving a small dose of very potent vampire blood behind.

While wearing it, your thoughts are buffered from the outside world by a soft white noise that varies from person to person as to what they actually hear.  Some hear the ocean, a fan blowing or paper crumpling.  Whatever the sound, it helps you to think faster and more creatively than before.

data.description: A compact crown boasting a built-in processor and several tiny projectors that beam information directly onto your eye.  It's equipped with enough internal storage and RAM to support a basic AI.  Along with multiple cameras providing 360-degree coverage, this setup enables you to tackle tasks far more efficiently than before.  Plus, there's a battle mode that activates an energy-intensive radiation detector.

data.description: This robust system begins at your hands, where it features a squarish steel frame enhanced with strategic protrusions to amplify impact damage by focusing the point of contact.  It extends along your forearms with thick, hardened steel shields protecting both your limbs and the underlying hydraulic mechanisms.  Aluminum tubes channel these hydraulics up into your upper arms, culminating at your back where the central hub for the hydraulic servos is located.  While the system recovers some energy with each movement, its substantial weight and bulk significantly limit the use of your hands for anything else.
An advanced version of the heavy CQC system.  It contain a self-recharging pneumatic tank that slowly builds pressure that you can use in a fight.

A bulky mess of coils and wires that goes from your fists to your shoulder, and a slot for a small battery behind the elbow.  Upon activation it will start to emit huge electrical charges, frying your enemies when attacked in melee.

A compressed melee sentry.  Ludicrous, physical law violating compression allows you to fit them into a small metal cylinder, but the weight compression is not as effective.

A small bill covered in odd symbols.  Tearing it will in turn cause a small dimensional tear located within a nearby entity.  Despite only lasting a few milliseconds, an internal tear in reality should be enough to kill anything.  Hopefully.

The greatest sandwich that will ever be made, in this universe and the next.  A quadruple stacker with beer-batter fried poultry, caramel chocolate chili, and topped with a specially made sauce of egg, blue cheese, honey mustard, BBQ and extremely concentrated vinegar that oozes down the other layers, before the entire thing is pressed and grilled in a waffle iron and finished with a garnish of gold and silver flakes and a fresh fruit skewered on top.  All the gourmet chefs in existence could not even conceive such a combination which, by all means, should not taste this good - But you did it.  And you don't plan on sharing.
data.//: ever order one of those overpriced sandwiches at a restaurant?

After 5 seconds, everything nearby will be violently sliced, warped, aged, and partially teleported straight into many different sections of the nether.  After a short moment of instant death, the dimensional gap will probably heal.  Probably.

data.description: This handgun looks like it came from some sci-fi journal.  It has a recharge slot that is somehow capable of using almost any type of battery.
A ray gun with lots of cylinders and whorling cables that light up. It has a recharge slot that is somehow capable of using almost any type of battery.
Pretty bulky, this laser rifle has double the amount of lenses and emitters, which makes it really devastating after some modding.

The Aetheric Death Ray, glowing a menacing green.  It hums with a barely controlled hatred of organic life.  It must recharge on its own, as there are no ports or battery slots on it.  It's sleek and smooth and evil.
A long, huge barrel drum mortar with a small device in the very end.  It is collapsible, and you can comfortably wear it using a strap.
So you decided to become an inventor and instead of inventing something good for mankind, you invented this?  You should be ashamed.
Something something ion, something something wide area.  Don't even ask.

A hand-made lever action sniper rifle with an extremely long barrel.  Logically such a barrel shouldn't function properly, but somehow it not only works well enough, it also accelerates the bullet much more than anyone could expect.  Two internal magazine tubes under the barrel accept 15 7.62x51 rounds each.

An abominably huge, two barrel Gast system shotgun.  Recoil from the first shot powers the piston that loads a shell into the second barrel, and vice versa, making it shoot approximately 1000rpm at max.  The biggest part of this weapon is a giant, multi tube magazine, which can store 240 shells at once.  It makes the weapon extremely bulky, so the only way you can utilize it is by handling it like a chainsaw or installing it on a turret base.

A carbine-sized particle cannon.  It shoots microscopic particles, and due the size of projectile you don't need to reload it for decades.  Instead, you need a ton of energy to generate enough magnetic force.  The damage of the weapon is not great, but it has perfect armor penetration, and no physical armor can stop its bullets.
Transformed from a tool, this weapon can emit giant clouds of energy, destroying everything on their path.
A default energy transformer that converts the power into raw energy.
A modified energy transformer.  It converts the power flow into a slow heat cloud that ignites everything around it.

A small, square tube with a pistol grip that can emit a sonic waves, creating cavitation and tissue damage inside living creatures.  It's pretty weak as a weapon, but using extremely high frequency sounds makes it silent for most creatures you can met.  It would be fun to listen some music using it, but alas.

A rifle-sized tool that can concentrate heat in a huge range.  It lost its ability to work as a tool as you don't want to accidentally evaporate your materials, but the damage output pays for this with interest.

A square abomination resembling a pistol, but with a collapsible outer magazine under the barrel.  This overengineered piece of metal is able to vary the size of chamber, which makes it able to shoot any round up to shotgun shells.  You spent a really long time to make it fit into a common holster.

A small cylinder, reminiscent of a muzzle booster.  It can be mounted onto the end of your barrel, which somehow increases the speed of the projectile.  It also makes the gun much louder and difficult to hold after each shot.
You can't properly explain how this thing works, but the end result should be clear - faster bullet with better damage, but awful dispersion.
This barrel attachment drastically decreases any sound that your gun emits.  Sadly, the damage and range of the weapon decrease respectively.
A choke that makes the pellets spread out wide to hit multiple enemies.  The pellets will have shorter range but somehow deals higher damage.
A set of mechanisms, that alter the action of the blocky pistol enough to make it something in-between a machine pistol and a submachine gun.
A set of modified weapon lens that increase the output energy of the laser at expense of its range.
A set of modified weapon lens that increases the range of the weapon at the price of its damage.
A set of powerful capacitors that increase the damage of a beam at the price of doubling power consumption.

A set of extremely powerful capacitors which can turn a common laser beam into powerful anti-materiel penetrator.  It spends five times more energy than the default capacitor, so you need a lot of batteries to use it.
A set of improved electric discharges, that uses energy more efficiently then standard.  It makes you spend much less energy per shot, but the overall output of a system is a bit smaller.
A set of fins in mathematically precise order, that make heat transferring much more efficient than your original implementation.
A small piece of completely frozen metal.  It grants a massive cooling improvement, but the weapon circuits don't work properly with this mod, making you spend more energy per shot.
Put some amount of the heat exchange from the gun back into platform loop.  Decrease amount of energy used, and increase the heat output of the weapon, but also its heat generation within the loop.

Alter the energy loop in the platform - instead of doing multiple shots, it store all the power, and use most of it in a single shot.  Effectively transform the weapon into one or two shot recoilless rifle.
Additional radiator for your energy weapon.  Someone may say it's because you don't know how to use your gun properly.
Replace the entire radiator in the platform into this hefty and bulky piece of metal, trading a portability of a gun for a massive overheat buffer.
Replace a large part of the weapon's radiator with an additional cooling unit.  The gun overheats faster, but recovers from it at a faster rate.
Replace a large portion of the radiator with additional capacitors.  The gun will barely cool off, but the damage output may be worth it.

A long, solid, crafted steel haft, and a bulky, comma-like head.  It feels really massive, but it is surprisingly easy to swing, and you will do more damage as your level increases.  You can throw it like a boomerang, and the damage of throw depend on your throwing skill level.
A hand-made lightened engine, with chain blades on a long stick.  The only reason it works without falling apart is because your calculations can't be wrong.

An extremely small and light tool that creates and transfers the heat in an extremely effective way.  You think it would be interesting to develop it further.
A simple intelligent agent to provide support in parsing big layers of information.

An enormous industrial press shaped device, covered in sensors, circuits, and other doodads.  Two inverted teleporters are located on each side of the hammers, poised to perfectly align at the end of a strike.  Doing so will smoothen the overall local barrier between Earth and other realities, filling in any holes at the expense of weakening it in a much wider area.  This is an overall positive effect, allowing you to heal tears that would never naturally close, but expect large temporary side-effects.
A small remote with a sharp spike at the end.  You can activate this device while poking it into a zone of frozen time in order to unfreeze the area you're touching.

data.description: A jagged and eldritch looking QR code ready to be placed wherever you are concerned about mechanical eyes.  Will trap cyborgs if they wander into it.
This is a knife that seems to be made of glass, but significantly more durable, like some sort of crystal with the strength of metal.

A thin piercing sword no wider than two fingers side by side, it's mirrored surface reflects the world back at it's wielders opponents and is difficult to see to parry.  You've never felt a sword like this before.
This sword is covered in shifting frost and seems to move of its own volition in your hands.
This sword is made all of a single piece of wood and so black any details are lost.  Some kind of shimmering leather is wrapped around the grip.
A giant bloodstained club, barely human wieldable with two hands.  You see shadowy tendrils of blood whenever it connects with an enemy, sticking to whatever it hits and burning like acid.

data.name: Blood Tendrils
data.description: Brownish reddish tendrils connect from the club to your enemies.
A gladius covered in the whorls of Celtic knots.  Sparks seems to pop off the edge of the blade.
A one-handed combat axe, the blade is slightly larger than a tomahawk.
A huge axe designed for warfare.  Made of forged dreamdross, and enchanted to channel heat into those it wounds.
Astute observers of Mesoamerican history may recognize this as a macuahuitl, the favored weapon of the Aztecs.  This macuahuitl looks as though it was made deep inside of a black mirror.

data.name: Distant Thunder
data.description: Sparks zap at your opponent.
Covered with thin layer of dreamdross, this knife is a light and sharp tool to work with.
It was a good tool before, but now it's covered with a thick layer of dreamdross, and it works as a light but deadly weapon.
A long stick that's been covered with dreamdross, but lacks any magical properties.

A long quarterstaff, forged entirely from dreamdross.  Twice as heavy than a wooden one, but lot sturdier, and still useful as a weapon.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
data.//: All dreamforged weapons are forged 100% from dreamdross. Wooden parts double their weight, but steel parts almost quarter their weight. 100% steel weapon like swords and knifes has too big benefit from it, so their damage is reduced respectively - the random properties will make them really good weapon anyway, but the basic stats will be sane enough.

data.description: A pair of a common glasses.  They have no lens or glass inside, only casing.  There is a strange engraving of vines, snakes, and foxes covering every surface of the frames.  You think that maybe the engravings are moving when you aren't looking at them.
A photo of a smiling family on a camping trip.  The background is always the same, but people are not.  Do you recall them?
A small, black sphere.  It constantly changes its position.  It even tries to roll out of corners you wedge it into.
This looks like a typical household flashlight.  It has no battery holder and it hums when you touch it.
A pin-shaped piece of iron.  You feel the need to hammer it.
A small, transparent bubble.  It divides itself into two, then four, eight, sixteen, endlessly, before turning back to single bubble and repeating the process.
A small shard of amber.  Looking carefully, you think you see some manner of creature trapped within.
A small, flat case used to carry currency.  Each time you open it, it reveals new pockets, but all of them hold the same one coin, which you can't remove.

data.name: action figurine

data.description: You see an incredibly detailed stone feather, almost lifelike in appearance.

data.name: monochrome arrow
data.description: You see a blocky arrow, unerringly pointed in some far off direction.  It is completely colorless.

data.name: odd circle
data.description: A circular unit of energy, surrounded by a few other circles that almost connect around the center.
You feel like something took a glance at this place, and it was so menacing that the world itself curled up.
A small lizard tail that was ripped off.  Looks like someone's joke.

These brass cylinders are engraved with cuneiform and could be rolled across wet clay to create a page of writing per cylinder.  When you touch one of the cylinders you hear a faint voice whisper 'Enki'.
A deck of intricately designed tarot cards.  When you lay out your future they seem to be trying to tell you to take a leap of faith.
An intricate occult seal.  When you glance at the bottom left corner you hear the sound of the ocean and smell the salty air of the sea, and sense a river flowing through each point of the seal.
An old style hurricane lamp.  The handle appears to made of vines covered in sharp thorns.
A box full of glass berries, when you get distracted you find yourself crunching them in your mouth.  Each one tastes like a mouthful of blood that slowly changes to espresso.

A polaroid of someone you remember going missing before the Cataclysm.  It caught a ton of media attention due to them being seen near what was shortly after identified as a thin place between dimensions.  The more you stare at the picture, the more you begin to see wounds appear and disappear on the person.  Sometimes they match your old scars.
A small jar with coffee, moving in weird patterns with no apparent cause.  After watching the swirls for some time, you are sure that it loops back on its movements, like some sort of message.
A red fabric blindfold with a cartoonish devil over the eyes.  You feel some anger when you put it on.  Did that devil just wink at you?
A human heart grown in mother of pearl.  It beats loudly when you raise it to your ear.
A tiny human eye.  You can clearly see the green iris and red capillaries.  While holding it in the dark you feel it watching you.
A small, smooth part of the human brain.  Looks slippery.  Feels like rubber.
A tiny human skull.  His empty orbits are watching you.
A small ring.  There is nothing special about it, except the word "Republic" embossed on it.
A tiny human eye.  You can clearly see it has a blue iris and red capillaries.  You feel it can see you no matter how you hide.

name.str_pl: copies of The Bathhouse at Midnight: An Historical Survey of Magic and Divination in Russia

data.description: This encyclopediac tome by W. F. Ryan concerns a wide variety of folk magic practices in pre-modern Russia, including their social context, the way that the Church had to work against folk practices like leaving items on the altar for six weeks so they would gain protective powers, the dangers of being alone in the bathhouse, ways to find and keep a husband or wife, when to throw an axe handle over your shoulder when walking into the forest, and how the government mostly suppressed magic because magical power (real or imagined) would have been a threat to secular power.  The description of some of these rituals are extremely detailed.

data.description: You spent years before the Cataclysm researching esoteric sciences and occult mysteries but only now in the heat of survival, have you experienced the epiphany that will allow you to create alchemical substances.
The days and weeks since the Cataclysm have been a blur of ideas and thoughts that you can only wish you had been able to think of before everything ended.
The things you've learned would have changed your life in the old days, you could have dropped out of the rat race and become a hidden master of the occult.
You've mastered the technique of cold forging iron from ingots into various items and weapons that are particularly effective against creatures from faerie myths.

At this stage in your occult education, normally you would start a small cabal of your own with apprentices that would engage in research and material gathering.  You would likely have several rich patrons financing you in return for alchemical medicines and goods to give them health and longevity.

Truly you have become one of the hidden occult masters of the world.  It's a pity that so few people are around for you to enjoy the benefits of your knowledge.  At least it's helping you to survive and maybe even thrive in this post-Cataclysm world.
Maybe you aren't a genius, but something inside of you grants previously hidden reserves of mana.

One of your ancestors spent their life fighting the monsters that stalk the night, and you have finally taken up their legacy, though you've also adopted their unusual weapon choice.  When wielding a whip, you do greatly-increased damage to vampires and renfields, and have a much easier time hitting their weakpoints.
You are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci, born alone in the wilderness.  With no parents, no kin, and no guidance, it's up to you to make your own way in the world.

data.name: Paraclesian Birth, Lost and Alone
data.description: Your first moments of life, born of the elements, alone.  An elemental fae on a dying world, lost in the wilderness.

data.name: Werewolf, Natural-born
data.description: You had no idea what was going on the first time it happened, when you woke up with mud on your bare feet and a sour taste in your mouth, but you were soon found.  The People of the Moon, they called themselves, and they said you were one of them.  A werewolf.  You lived out in the wilderness for a while with them.  Maybe some of the People are still out there.

data.name: Werewolf, Naked and Unafraid
data.description: You have no idea what happened, but you're alone in the unspoiled wilderness.  You have mud on your feet, none of your clothes or possessions, and you don't know where you are.  But you have learned there's a beast inside you, and anyone who crosses you had best beware.

data.name: The Owl, Naked and Afraid
data.description: For most or all of your life, you've had a secret; you are a predator.  While you don't need to drink blood or eat flesh or anything so crude, you must absorb the spiritual essence, the "ruach", of living beings in order to maintain your health and vitality.  Something happened, and now you're alone in the wilderness, without any of your possessions.  You'd best find others quick, or you'll wither away.

data.name: Once Bitten
data.description: Whether you were visiting Salem's Lot, boating on the Demeter, vacationing to Transylvania, or just another lost boy or girl, you've been bitten by a stranger at twilight the night before.  And to make matters worse, when you woke up, you were alone in the wilderness with no sign of humanity anywhere.  You're going to have to survive somehow.

data.name: Xedra Evolved
data.description: An urban fantasy content mod for Agent Mulder in the apocalypse.  Creates a multi decade timeline of dimensional spillage prior to the Cataclysm.  This spillage was characterized by thin places appearing where people could step through into another dimension, but things from those dimensions could wander into our world as well.  XEDRA proliferated into an alphabet soup of agencies dedicated to simultaneously stopping, controlling, and utilizing these thin places with varying degrees of success.  Contains monsters of various types, new professions and locations, new uses for existing skills,the new deduction skill, new magic systems, and content of every type that a multidimensional Cataclysm has to offer.  This is a heavily science-fantasy mod where you are as likely to encounter supernatural monsters as you are UFOs, Sasquatch, and Chupacabra.  Please examine the readme.md file for further details.

data.description: Your half-dead flesh is inured to winter's chill.  As long as you have empowered blood in your body, you suffer much less from colder temperatures.

The deathly energies that course through your veins are inimical to mundane poisons and diseases.  As long as you have empowered blood in your body, you are more resistant to disease, poison, and infection.

While unable to ignore gravity like a true vampire, it has less of a hold on you.  You can fall one story without ill effect and take greatly-reduced fall damage as long as you have empowered blood in your body.
Being born closer to death, you feel the sensations of the living less strongly.  You suffer much less pain from your injuries than a human would, and the pain affects your capabilities less.

data.description: You are only half-alive now, sustained as much by the energy in your blood as by biological processes.  You age far slower than a mortal, and when your limbs break, they heal more quickly in proportion to how much empowered blood you have.

While you must normally eat, sleep, and drink as a mortal must, in times of need you can put that off.  Activate this trait to reduce your need for food, water, and sleep to zero.  While active, the Blood is the Life will continually expend the power in your blood, and when it wears off, you will become exhausted in proportion to how long the trait was active.  You spend <color_yellow>much more blood</color> if outdoors in the sunlight.

data.description: While you won't burn in the sunlight like a true vampire, it's not comfortable.  You suffer a -1 penalty to all stats when outdoors during the daytime, and an additional -2 if it's sunny or clear.
You aren't forced to slumber the day away, but you sure want to.  Your sleepiness accumulates much faster while the sun is in the sky, but you have an easier time sleeping during the day.
Being so close to death has slowed down the processes of your living cells considerably.  You heal at 50% of the normal rate.
Animals can sense your dead blood and they hate it.  They may run or be aggressive to you.
While running water is not deadly to you, it is uncomfortable.  Moving through running water without a boat will cause pain.
Your skin has the obviously-unnatural grayish-white tinge of a corpse, and mortals will react appropriately to seeing it.
The vampires are right about one thing; they are better than humans, and your vampire blood makes you better as well.
You have tasted blood and that taste forever lingers in the back of your mind.  You will get cravings for blood that only time or drinking more blood can sate.
Fresh blood has an energy that mortal food simply cannot compare to.  You gain 33% reduced kcal from the food you eat, but additional calories from drinking blood.

You can now spend blood while talking with someone else to make them like you more, with the costliest application of this power being able to turn them into your obsessed servants.  Not all can be influenced by this power, for anger, panic and strong ties to a group that isn't yours will disrupt the process.  Other vampires and the rare saint-blooded are also immune to it.

Unlike lesser vampires who bloat as they gorge on blood, you concentrate the blood you consume, making it fit nicely in your veins.  This removes the penalties for containing too much blood, but doesn't expand your maximal capacity.

You can shroud your body and what you are carrying with shadows, amplifying your combat ability but preventing communication and using other powers until you return to your normal form.  It also costs blood for every second you spend in that state.
