data.//2: Safe: Vampire-filled holy places, the New England Community Church, anywhere not unsafe.

name.str: Vampiric weakness: melted by vast water

data.description: Your flesh will melt should you ever try to cross a large body of water or get too close to them.  Only rivers, lakes and oceans have enough water to trigger this weakness, but it will take effect even if floating or water-walking.
data.//: Unsafe: rivers, lakes, oceans.

data.description: Animals cannot tolerate your wicked presence.  Expect any animal you encounter to either flee or attack you on sight.
Fire damages you far more than it should.  You take massive damage from fire and flames, mundane and magical.

name.str: Vampiric weakness: cold as a corpse

data.description: You now lack amy body heat.  You feel colder at all times, and being cold will slow you down.

You now need to drink some fresh, warm blood from a living being once in a while or suffer growing penalties.  You better find someone willing to share their blood, as blood from fresh corpses won't satisfy this need.
Your ability to process varied types of blood is now hampered.  Blood that isn't regular human blood will only sate your thirst half as much.
Your thirst for blood will occasionally magnify, causing painful cravings.  You can calm these cravings as or before they happen by consuming blood.

name.str: Vampiric weakness: barred from mortal joys

data.description: Blood is the only thing that can bring a smile to your lips.  Nothing else gives you any lasting joy or pleasure.  It is impossible for you to be truly happy unless you recently consumed blood.

data.//: Required for vampire blood to have any consumption benefit.  Regular vampires instinctively feel threatened by you and their renfields try to protect them, so they react accordingly.
data.//2: The traits unlocked by this have no category, as they aren't given by the regular mutation system.
data.description: Through the consumption of self-cannibalizing vampire blood, you gained the ability to consume vampire blood to gain vampiric abilities undreamt of by other vampires.
Your vestigial circulatory system is now better at holding stolen blood.  You can hold five more liters inside you.
Your ability to see in the dark has expanded.  You no longer need to spend blood to maintain your gleaming eyes.
You can now attract the blood within a corpse's veins, extracting it all in a second through a small cut.  In addition, you can create temporary blood containers by spending mana.
In comparison to you, regular vampires are the same as mortals.  You can now detect nearby vampires, your new prey, even through walls.

Your digestive system has warped to repurpose some vestigial parts, making you much better at drinking blood.  Drinking reasonable amounts of blood won't ever stretch your stomach, and you drink blood much faster now.
Your supernatural senses have expanded.  You can now see anything close to some nocturnal creatures, even if they lack sight.

data.//: The main draw of BLOOD_FUN is fae blood being a net morale positive.  The main draw of this upgrade is getting stat boosts from the high morale.
data.description: Becoming more vampire than vampires are has affected your new palate, making the consumption of blood feel even better than before.  You now enjoy drinking blood so much that enough of it will bolster your resolve for a while.
Your lack of movement noise is now encompassing any noise you could do in combat.  All such noises you would've made by attacking in melee are nullified.

data.//: Behaves as the anathema's threshold, letting the EOC give the stronger traits.  The enabler is a threshold to limit mixing regular mutations and this path.
data.//2: A few mentors knew that this was possible, but they kept the secret to not threaten the plan.
data.description: You drank enough vampire blood to gain access to power the mentors never thought possible.  There is no more limit to how powerful of a vampire you can be.
Your new power allows you to store even more stolen blood inside your body.  You can hold another ten liters inside you.

data.//: should only work in the dark, but such checks aren't yet.
data.description: Darkness is your home, and you can call it to shroud you from others.  When away from the sun, you can become invisible with a constant expense of blood.
data.//2: This enchantment removes the effect if the vampire is outside at day.

data.//: should only work in the dark, but such checks aren't yet.
data.description: Darkness is your new friend, and like a good friend it helps you through hard times.  Passively heal your wounds and reduce your pain while away from the sun.

The powers of vampires come through their sustenance of blood, and you now know how to use this at your advantage.  You can increase your need for blood to boost your vampiric potency until you decide to stop the effect.  If you do not have enough blood, it will have no effect until you drink more blood.
data.activation_msg: Your power increases as your blood burns away.

data.description: Increases blood potency and drain while the player-visible version is active and has enough blood.  You should never see this.

Being protected against mundane afflictions only is something your flesh has stopped tolerating.  Your condition now protects you from any illness, parasite and poison, no matter how dangerous they are.
You are much more attuned to your other forms, and they are now easier to activate than ever.  The cost to activate them is halved.
Your instinctive mastery of your mist form has expanded.  You now recover from triggering Last Breath's Mist twice as quickly.
Vampires, mortals, they are all the same for you now.  Drinking vampire blood now gives all the benefits of drinking regular blood, in addition to growing your power.
Your own blood now reveals its secrets to you.  Every week, you will gain a new gift of the blood.  It will only give you what researching your blood gifts could give you.

name.str: Maximal Mastery of the Mortal Mind

data.description: Your mind-control abilities are much simpler to use now, halving their cost.

name.str: Anathema's Weakness: Slain by the Sun

data.description: Vampires burn under the sun, and becoming more of a vampire made you burn far more than any other vampire would.  While under the sun, you will take constant damage no matter how covered you are.

Your constant consumption of vampire blood has permanently destabilized your mind, and it will only grow worse with each new vampire drained.  Each time you drink vampire blood, you have a growing chance to gain a new mental affliction.

Drinking all this vampire blood has left your body yearning for more.  Going too long without drinking vampire blood will progressively increase your thirst for blood with each passing day until you starve or drink vampire blood.

Through a complicated ritual utilizing a saint's relic, you have transubstantiated your own blood with the holy blood of the saints.  It'll prevent you from becoming infected with vampirism while you live, effects postmortem unknown.
You aren't where you seem to be.
You are no longer limited to the five senses common to most humans in your hunt for the unnatural.
Boann bestowed upon you the right to summon a few daffodil warriors once a day.
You were born with an allergy to iron and, to a lesser extent, steel.  Wearing or touching anything made of iron or steel will cause you pain and discomfort.
The Fair Folk can sense the stolen power within you and their vengeance will be terrible.
The arvore can sense the stolen power within you and they will not react well to it.
The homullus can sense the stolen power within you and they will not react well to it.
The salamanders can sense the stolen power within you and they will not react well to it.

description.str: Intended to be hidden.  Makes Boann teleport the player away, spawns some huntsmen and hounds then cure all her ailments and injuries if she survives being hit by the player.

data.//: No cold armor here--trees are very vulnerable to ice breaking their limbs

descriptions.text: The forest nervously whispers to you about the presence of humans.
The forest gently whispers to you about the creatures of nature.
The forest whispers warnings of unnatural creatures nearby.

description.str: Sometimes, when an enemy punches your thorns, they hurt themselves.

data.//: General principle for spells below is--spells that involving growing or nurturing plants in the long-term are intelligence-based, other spells are perception-based.  Briarwall (long-term) is thus Intelligence, whereas Hungry Thirsty Roots is Perception because the roots die within minutes.
data.name: Commune with Nature
data.description: You concentrate on nature around you and commune with it, improving your health and calming the nearby wildlife.  This spell may only be cast outdoors in natural surroundings.

data.name: Cultivate Goblin Fruit
data.description: You may spin a bit of fae magic into a plant, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast outdoors in natural surroundings.

data.name: Treesinging
data.description: Using your voice and your magic, bring forth living wood from a tree to provide resources without harming the forest.
data.message: You close your eyes and sing to the trees.

data.name: Verdant Infusion
data.description: You draw on your own connection to nature and infuse some of its power into one of your allies, healing them for a small amount and increasing their overall health.

data.name: Roots Crack the Foundation
data.description: Roots can grow through even concrete given time.  With this spell, you can compress that time into a single instant to shatter walls or rip doors off their hinges.

data.name: Call the Children of the Roots
data.description: A lesser wood spirit is summoned to support you.

While in the wild, weave together some leaves and grasses and magick to form a container that will keep its contents from rotting for a length of time.  The container will only last a few weeks at most.

description.str: The actual spell that summons the container.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: Viridescent Vessel
data.description:
Trees require water but will still drown if submerged.  This spell allows the Arvore to create a floral boat with the help of a nearby tree, letting them travel safely across water.

You must be standing <color_yellow>next to a tree</color> and <color_yellow>near the water</color> for the spell to be effective.

description.str: The actual spell to summon the boat.  If you have it, it's a bug.

data.name: Briarwall
data.description: Call up thick briars and thorns, either in a line to form a wall or an arc to trap an enemy.  They will grow to full size in moments.

description.str: Call up briars and thorns, either in a line to form a wall or an arc to trap an enemy.  They will grow to full size in moments.
Call up briars and thorns, either in a line to form a wall or an arc to trap an enemy.  They will grow to full size in moments.

data.name: Tending the Garden
data.description: Invasive weeds must be rooted out, lest they choke the life from the garden.  This spell inflicts a rapid withering on plants and fungus within its area of effect.

description.str: This is the fungicidal effect of the Tending the Garden spell.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
Pull a target to you.

data.name: Nurturing the Green
data.description: You can greatly speed plant growth.  Grass can grow from seed in moments, crops can be brought to ripeness, and even young trees will reach their full bloom.

data.name: Spreading the Viridian Mantle
data.description: Rather than fostering the growth of a single plant, you can cause a wave of growth all around you, affecting an entire field and bringing it towards ripeness.

data.name: The Forest Offers Shelter
data.description: In natural surroundings, you can create structures out of living wood--walls, floors, doors, and roofs all together.

description.str: The walls part of the Forest Offers Shelter spell.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
The floor part of the Forest Offers Shelter spell.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
The branches part of the Forest Offers Shelter spell.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
The doors part of the Forest Offers Shelter spell.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: Creeper Ascends the Wall
data.description: Cause a cluster of vines to burst out of diggable ground and rise up into the sky in moments.  It will be easy to climb once its growth is finished.
data.message: The soil churns as thick vines burst forth and shoots toward the sky.

data.name: Den of Brambles
data.description: When outside on diggable ground, create a small structure of wood near the Arvore, offering shelter against the elements.
Your command over plants allows you to cause grass to grow in profusion from the soil, making the terrain very difficult for enemies to traverse.

name.//~: The name is a reference to the poem "Goblin Market" by Christina Rossetti.

data.description: Your command over plants allows you to call forth roots from the earth to clutch and grasp at your enemies.

data.name: Perennial Rebirth
data.description: Bind your soul to the heart of the forest, rebirthing yourself if you should die.  You may only perform this in thick forests or at an arvore altar, you may be reborn no more than once in a lunar month.

data.name: Overgrowth
data.description: While outdoors and not underground, the Arvore can create a profusion of life around themselves, causing grass to grow through pavement, bushes and flowers to sprout, and trees to grow to full height in moments.

data.name: Fallen Trees Decay to Soil
data.description:
Even the mightiest tree returns to soil in the end.  The Arvore may channel this natural process into an area around themselves, infecting everyone within with the energies of rot.

<color_yellow>This spell is indiscriminate</color> and <color_red>should not be used near allies</color>.

data.name: Traverse the Wilds
data.description: Roots grow together and so forests are connected.  The Arvore may use this connection to quickly transport themselves tree to tree, stepping into an adjacent tree and then stepping out of another one within the spell's range.

description.str: Roots grow together and so forests are connected.  The Arvore may use this connection to quickly transport themselves tree to tree, stepping into an adjacent tree and then stepping out of another one within the spell's range.

data.name: From Root to Root the Forest Is Joined
data.description: All forests are connected at their hearts.  You can use this connection to travel from the depths of a forest to the depths of another forest, if you properly attune to your destination.

data.name: Root to Root Attunement
data.description: Attune to a location for later traveling.  You must attune within the depths of a forest.

description.str: The actual Root to Root attunement spell.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: Verdant Imprisonment
data.description: The ultimate expression of nature's power, you can turn your target into a tree that might have stood for a century or more.  It works best on an already-weakened target, and does not work at all on non-organic targets.

description.str: This is the banishment that the target casts on themselves.

data.name: Embrace of the Verdant Mother
data.description:
While outdoors and not underground, the Arvore can unleash the power of nature against their enemies.  The walking dead and most creatures not native to the world suffer the Earthmother's wrath, while animals and humans are healed.  Triffids, being plants, are healed as well.

Note that this power is <color_yellow>indiscriminate</color>: if the Arvore has somehow bound a Nether creature to their service, it will be damaged, and hostile humans will be healed.
Your skin has turned the color of spring growth.  Your skin is now a viridian green.  This has no gameplay effects.
Your skin has turned into a type of plant matter, which in addition to any armoring slows your loss of fluids.
The skin on your body has grown into a barklike state.  This provides significantly more armor but reduces flexibility.

data.//: This needs its own ID to be only a type SKIN mutation
data.description: It's subtle, but your skin has definitely taken on a sickly yellow-green hue.
A viridian moss has grown on your skin, forming whorls and eldritch patterns, providing some protection from the cold and the wet.  It also provides a small amount of armor against acid or fire.
You are in tune with the forest and the triffids will allow you safe passage in their lands, so long as you do not harm them.

The trees recognize you as one of their own and allow you to pass easily beneath their boughs.  The grass moves under your feet to speed your passage, and shrubs bend out of the way.  When walking on grass, trees, or other natural foliage, your movement speed is increased.

The trees recognize you as one of their own and allow you to pass easily beneath their boughs.  The grass moves under your feet to speed your passage, and shrubs bend out of the way. Upon gaining this ability the Arvore may greatly speed plant growth.  With enough practice, you will even be able to bring forth mighty trees from the dry earth.
data.//: This only causes growth in existing plants.  Growing new plants from nothing should be advanced mutations/spells.

data.description: Arvore with this ability have a seed pocket on their body that over time fills with a set of from this region of the world.  Each time new seeds appear they will all be of the same type, but the types will vary at random.
data.//: This is currently character creation only, ideally there will be ways to get this later in game.

data.description: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore may create structures of living wood on natural terrain.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to draw on the peace and strength of nature while standing in a wild area.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to summon thick tangles of briars to form walls or entrap their enemies.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to transport themselves from tree to nearby tree while within a forest.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to induce decay and dissolution in the surrounding area.

name.str: Call the Children of the Roots

data.description: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to summon a wood spirit.
Upon gaining this ability, the Arvore gains the ability to summon semitangible roots that will shatter walls and furniture.

name.str: From Root to Root the Forest Is Joined

data.description: Upon gaining this ability, the Arvore gains the ability to travel great distances, even dozens of miles, in moments, as long as they start and end their journey within the depths of a forest.
Upon gaining this ability, the Arvore gains the ability to cause rapid plant growth in a radius around themselves.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to bind their soul to the heart of the forest, rebirthing themselves when on the verge of death.
You have bound your soul to the forest, and death will merely be a momentary inconvenience.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to infuse their companions with the vitality of the forest.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to cause grass to rapidly grow on fertile terrain, slowing their enemies.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to summon a thick climbing vine from diggable ground.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to damage plant and fungal entities, including others of their own kind.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit when in natural areas away from civilization.
The Arvore are closely tied with the forests and may commune with the trees to learn the layout of the land.  Activate this ability to enter the communion.
Drawing out the power inherent in growing wood makes weapons composed of it more deadly in your hands.  You do increased damage when wielding a weapon primarily made of wood.
With a brief effort of will, the Arvore may infuse their blood with a poison that harms any who bite them.
data.activation_msg: Your skin itches.

data.description: The Arvore may release clouds of pollen that ruin the coordination of their enemies when breathed in.
data.activation_msg: The air fills with clouds of pollen.

data.description: Like a tree, you are fueled by the sun.  When standing in the sunlight, you will absorb its energy as nutrients and heal slightly faster.
data.//: No messages so you aren't constantly spammed while you're walking in and out of buildings.  Being a fae spirit, the arvore doesn't need uncovered arms or head or anything--simply being in the sun is enough.

data.description: Like a tree, you are fueled by the sun.  When standing in the sunlight, you will absorb its energy as nutrients, heal slightly faster, and your mana regenerates much quicker.
data.//: No messages so you aren't constantly spammed while you're walking in and out of buildings.  Being a fae spirit, the arvore doesn't need uncovered arms or head or anything--simply being in the sun is enough.

data.description: Your energy changes with the seasons: in spring and summer, you're more awake and need less sleep, and the reverse is true in autumn and winter.

Like a tree, you draw nourishment from the sun and the soil.  When standing in the sunlight and on natural terrain, you absorb its energy as food.  You still need to drink water and you will still get hungry.
Filled with the energy of life, pain does not affect you as strongly.
At will, you can extend a cluster of grasping vines to grab one target and drag them in.  They have a range equal to 1/2 your Dexterity.
data.activation_msg: Vines lash out toward your target.

data.description: At will, you can transform your hands into jagged wooden claws.  They are potent weapons but make anything other than combat more difficult.
data.activation_msg: Your fingers itch as jagged wood rapidly covers them.

data.description: Your hands are transformed into jagged wooden claws.  You can use them to attack, but performing mundane tasks will be harder.
Plants lose their leaves in winter, but that does not kill them, they simply sleep until the spring comes.  The cold bothers you less now.
Pine trees keep their leaves even in the coldest winter.  The cold bothers you now not at all.
By the places of the sun and the moon, you can always tell exactly what time it is, as long as you're not underground.
The wilderness welcomes you as one of its own, and you have an easier time surviving there and making things from its bounty.  +1.5 Survival skill.
Like green wood, you can bend your limbs easily.  You gain a +4 bonus to Dexterity.
Like the seedling poking through the soil, you have great strength hidden within you.  +1 Strength.
Like the young tree reaching for the sun, your limbs are filled with power.  +3 Strength.
Like forest giants that have stood for a hundred years, you are unshakeable.  +5 Strength.
When one tree in a grove is attacked by insects, soon all trees will produce the deterrent.  +3 Perception.
The forest recognizes your kinship and will hide you beneath its boughs.  When in a forest or in thick foliage, enemies will have a harder time spotting you.
data.//: Ideally there'd be some way to detect what sort of terrain was nearby and you'd need a critical mass of foliage, but the below will work for now.

data.description: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore's eyes begin reflecting the seasons: a bright yellow-green in spring; verdant green in summer; red, yellow, or orange in autumn, and dark brown in winter.  Glare no longer impacts them.
The Arvore's ears are longer and pointed, more "leaf-shaped."  While they cannot hear any better, like the trees in the deep forest, they are unphased by loud sounds.

data.//: Visibility here because the Arvore's skin flushes a different color when the blood isn't red.
data.description: The Arvore's blood is now composed of sap and vegetable matter.  This does not benefit or harm them in any ways, but humans will be discomfited by it.
The Arvore's blood is a sticky sap that oozes rather than gushes from their wounds.  They will bleed more slowly than normal.

The Arvore's blood is a sticky sap that oozes rather than gushes from their wounds and has potent defensive properties.  They will bleed more slowly than normal and are immune to parasites and infection.

The Arvore's blood is a sticky sap that oozes rather than gushes from their wounds and aggressively fights back against invading organisms.  They will bleed much more slowly than normal, are immune to parasites and infection, and cannot be transformed by the Mycus.

At will, the Arvore can grow long vines from their shoulders and back.  They can be used to climb or to lash at enemies, and can also be detached to serve as a rope if necessary.  Activate to toggle vines on and off.
data.activation_msg: Lashing vines grow from your shoulders.

data.description: In the whispers of the leaves and the movement of the grasses, the forest warns you of nearby creatures.  While the forest can distinguish between a bird and a zombie, some fine distinctions are still lost to it.

In the whispers of the leaves and the movement of the grasses, the forest warns you of nearby creatures.  While the forest can distinguish between a bird and a zombie, some fine distinctions are still lost to it.  Also, you can see further when you're standing in a forest.
Your hair now has flowers and small vines and leaves growing in it.  It's pleasant to look at but has no further game effect.
The flowers in your hair produce a pleasant smell, obvious without being overpowering.  You no longer smell anything like a human and other beings will react to you appropriately.

Every rose has its thorn and so do you.  With a moment's concentration, you can exude thorns through your skin that have a chance of damaging attackers while increasing the damage of your unarmed attacks.  However, you cannot wear rigid armor over your thorns.
data.activation_msg: Stiff wooden thorns push out from your skin.

data.description: You are exuding thorns through your skin that have a chance of damaging attackers while increasing the damage of your unarmed attacks.  However, you cannot wear rigid armor over your thorns.

The flowers in your hair produce an intoxicating smell.  You no longer smell anything like a human and other beings will react to you appropriately.  You can enhance this scent to an overpowering level, beguiling humans and making them more suggestible at the cost of greatly increasing the range at which others can smell you.
data.activation_msg: A sweet scent fills the air.

description.str: The active version of Enchanting Aroma.  Should not be player visible.

data.description: When in wild areas, you can draw on the revitalizing power of the land to heal yourself.  When in natural areas, your limbs will heal much faster.

You may transform into a tree, extending roots and spreading leaves out to the sun.  You will heal faster, gain more benefit from sleep, and almost all monsters will ignore you, but you will only be dimly aware of the outside world and will be nearly unable to move.
data.activation_msg: Your legs fuse together and your arms stretch toward the sky as you put down roots and transform into a towering tree.

data.description: You are a tree.  You will heal much more quickly and resting is more beneficial.  You are unable to see, hear, or move, but have a dim awareness of nearby movement.
data.//: Healing values copied from the Regeneration mutation
data.//2: NETHER_EMANATION missing from the above list is deliberate--they hone in on mental activity and the transformed Arvore still thinks.

data.//: No messages so you aren't constantly spammed while you're walking in and out of buildings.  Being a fae spirit, the arvore doesn't need uncovered arms or head or anything--simply being in the sun is enough.

data.name: One of Us
data.description: Insinuate yourself into a feral human's mind, tricking them into thinking you are an ally.

data.name: Calling the Lost and the Damned
data.description: Feral humans come to your aid.

data.name: Everything Will Be Fine
data.description: Sometimes, it is best to focus on the positive.  This spell increases the Homullus's mood when cast.

data.name: A Face in the Crowd
data.description: Though the teeming masses of humanity are gone, the Homullus can evoke their anonymizing essence with magick, rendering them invisible to any humans affected by the spell.

data.name: Sense the Night Hunters
data.description: Weaving this glamour will allow you to sense the presence of nearby vampires.
data.message: You mutter a charm under your breath and feel for those who subsist on stolen blood.

name.str: A Face in the Crowd Self

description.str: Puts an effect on you so anyone affected by A Face in the Crowd knows to ignore you.  It's a bug if you have this directly.

data.name: The Average Joe
data.description: Weave a cloak of glamour around a target, making it more difficult for enemies to spot them.  This is not invisibility, and getting to close to a hostile target will allow them to see through the magick.

data.name: Dynamo
data.description: Fueled by the power charging your leylines, touch a target to restore some of the power in a vehicle or power grid.

data.name: The Scholar's Regard
data.description: Unlike plants or animals, humans study subjects unrelated to survival.  This spell focuses the Homullus's mind, allowing easier learning.

data.name: Discover Goblin Fruit
data.description: With the aid of a bit of fae magick, you may find a goblin fruit abandoned among the ruins.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast in the remnants of civilization.

data.name: All Roads Lead to Rome
data.description: Humanity crisscrossed the Earth with roads, first small tracks, then earthen projects, and finally mighty asphalt webs upon which billions of people traveled every day.  The Homullus can stand on the remnants of that web and return to any remaining locus of civilization that they have attuned to.

data.name: All Roads Lead to Rome Attunement
data.description: Attune to a location for later traveling.  You must attune at one of the remaining bastions of civilization or concentrations of humanity.

name.str: All Roads Lead to Rome Attunement Real

description.str: The actual All Roads Lead to Rome attunement spell.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.description: Your skin has turned pearlescent white, similar to antique dolls.  This has no gameplay effects.
Your skin has smoothed and all your prior blemishes have faded away.  This somewhat reduces wet effects and leads to a more durable yet harder to heal body.
Your skin has become latex like.  While it provides additional protection and attractiveness it also heals at a much slower rate.
Upon gaining this ability the Homullus's eyes begin change to look like doll's eyes, always staring at the world.  Glare no longer impacts them.
'Men were deceivers ever,' as the quotation runs.  To be human is to be a liar.  You are much more successful at lying to people now.
From the dreams of mortals, you can spin remnants of fantasy into material substance.  When you sleep near mortals, you have a chance to awaken with some dreamdross nearby.
data.//: Ideally this would detect even non-allied NPCs nearby instead of just a location where NPCs are likely to be

data.description: With this ability, the Homullus can reach out to a feral's fractured mind and twist it, convincing them to function as an ally.
The Dollkin has resistance to attacks on its ability to act on it's choices.
Your powers enhance your mundane senses and allow you to detect human beings.
This and other abilities native to Dollkin suggest that if vampires did create cities to concentrate their prey, something evolved afterwards to complicate the hunting grounds.
The world crawls with the hungry dead and those who may as well be dead while they still live.  This allows the Homullus to call one of the latter to their side.
A habit of lying is hard to break, even when, or especially when, talking to oneself.  This trait grants the Homullus a spell that allows them to smooth out any negative moods they experience.
Upon gaining this ability the Homullus gains the ability to render themselves invisible to humans.

Regardless, it is your gift and your curse now, and you must use your powers to survive.

data.name: XE843 'Gracken' (Species)
data.description: Species XE843 is how the Xedra scientists identified your people before they learned your people could speak to them after enough time around them to develop a way to communicate.  They had little idea that communication is your people's survival trait, coming from a much harsher environment than the humans are…were blessed with, you can make allies with almost any thinking being.  You informed the Xedra people of your race's name 'Gracken' but you didn't tell them that most of your people they found were larval forms and lacking access to the shadow materials needed would never grow up into an adult form.  Now the humans' world is as deadly or moreso than your home and the way back is mostly closed.  Time to try and find a route home that wouldn't be a death sentence, or see what this world has to offer.

data.description: You know how to make a helmet that will increase your creative abilities.  Even with this improvement you don't really know how it works, it just came to you in a flash of brilliance.

data.name: Make The Ion Rifle
data.description: Craft a small weapon that does… things, that allow you to… kill… things… whatever, you have no idea how it works.

data.name: Minor Spark of Inspiration
data.description: Enters a manic creation episode in the appropriate workshop space and creates… something.

data.name: Inquire Dreamdross
data.description: You spend some time, trying to understand what the dreamdross is capable of, and how you can utilize it's power.

data.name: Forge Dreamdross
data.description: This ritual pulls a small amount of dreamdross into our world and makes it permanent.  These scraps of dreaming can then be used to make permanent objects.

data.name: Commune with the Ancient Oaks
data.description: This spell allows you to speak to the trees and discern the layout of the forest.

data.name: From Root to Root the Forest Is Joined Real
data.description: The actual spell that transports you for From Root to Root the Forest Is Joined.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: Consume human blood
data.description: You consume human blood to keep the thirst at bay.

data.name: Eye gleam
data.description: Gives you the power to see in the dark.
data.message: Your eyes glow red for a moment.  Now your sight can pierce the darkest shadows.

data.name: Stamina from blood
data.description: You focus on sending the blood in your veins to where it can do the most good for your immediate stamina.

data.name: Coagulant Weave
data.description: Turning your blood mastery inwards, magically enhancing your flesh.  Rather than strength of healing, it staves off blood loss and purges wounds before they can turn septic, at the cost of increased hunger and thirst.

data.name: Blood-Driven Speed
data.description: Stolen blood allows you to move as quick as lightning, scything through your enemies or outrunning a car.

data.name: (Bat Form) Ascend
data.description: Flap your wings and fly upward.

description.str: This is the actual spell that reduces thirst for tree form.

data.name: The Wind Blows, the Willow Bends
data.description: Like the flitting wind or the flexible willow, the spell allows you to avoid attacks much more easily.  It has <color_yellow>reduced effects</color> away from your natural environment (indoors for Sylph, non-natural terrain for Arvore).

description.str: Are you the Bat Man?
Are you the Bat Man?

data.name: Awakened Eater
data.description: Ever since the Cataclysm you've been able to clearly see elements of other realities that have intruded your own.  You also are able to consume a resource they seem to have brought with them to give you power far beyond a normal human.

data.name: Awakened Dreamer
data.description: Ever since the Cataclysm you've become far more aware of the weakened gap between realities.  Specifically, of what is on the other side.  Surprisingly, it doesn't seem universally hostile, and you think you'd be able to bring some of these entities over if you desired.

data.name: Awakened Inventor
data.description: Ever since the Cataclysm you've begun having crazy ideas on how to create technological devices.  While conventional logic would label these designs as silly or even insane, something tells you that they'd work regardless.

data.name: Awakened Dreamsmith
data.description: Ever since the Cataclysm you've gained an instinctive sense of how to work dreamdross into tools and armor.  It will still take some effort to put these vague ideas to proper use.

data.name: Dhampir (Species)
data.description: One of your parents was always a little odd.  They stayed out of the sun as much as they could, their eyes were a bit of an odd color, and they vanished without a trace before you grew old enough to ask them why they left the room every time you got a scrape that drew blood.  But now that you're older, you understand.  You are the child of a vampire, and have inherited a small portion of their power.

data.name: Paraclesian Birth
data.description: By dint of your birth you already have some knowledge of how the universe really works.

data.name: Born with the gift of gab.
data.description: You've never met another person but already you are ready for the conversations that will ensue.

data.name: Knack of formless movement.
data.description: Water takes on the shape of whatever opening is given to it.  You were born with this knowledge and way of moving.

data.name: Everywhere and nowhere.
data.description: Air expands to fill every space it encounters and by filling the space it becomes diffuse and impossible to grasp.  Would you slip through the fingers of those who grasp at you?

data.name: Born a seedbearer.
data.description: A gift from your birth world?  A quirk of nature?  For reasons unknown to you, you can sprout seeds from this planet.  You can't control what seeds you get, however.

data.name: Fire dances with itself.
data.description: At your birth you already danced a flaming path, enthralled with your own capacity for destruction and change.

data.name: What does the stone dream of?
data.description: Before you were born, your thoughts and dreams were those of stone.  When this world sucks you into it's highs and lows, you can remember the eternity that is stone.
data.//: Trait grants an EOC that doing 30 minutes of meditation resets your morale to zero.  Consider making IERDE abilities that function better or only at morales between the range of -15 and 15.

data.name: FBI Paranormal Investigator
data.description: Before the Cataclysm, you used to work for the Paranormal Investigation Department of the FBI.  You got used to jokes at your expense, as well as being constantly underfunded and disregarded by your superiors.  You were returning from yet another case with nothing but a bag of suspicious candies to show, when all hell broke loose.  Oh well, at least now you can be certain that everyone still alive will believe you that the truth is out there.

data.name: Xedra Response Team Member
data.description: Before Xedra recruited you, you probably worked for the ATF or a PMC like Kroll.  It was your job to investigate any cross-pollination incidents where alternate physics regions crossed over the Nether and reached our world.  Part exterminator part investigator, you made sure that any new resources and contaminants were accounted for, including any intelligent life trying to sneak into our world.  Local law enforcement and civilians called you 'Zebras' since your identification and badges only had a barcode instead of any name/rank/number.  This job has shown you things you don't want to remember but luckily the Zebra docs seem to have an endless supply of pills.

data.name: Foreign Agent
data.description: You came here from another country trying to gain access to secrets the United States had ripped from other worlds.  They probably had sent people to your homeland to do the same.  You were out performing recon when the Cataclysm struck and caught a ride with a stranger trying to find safety.  Sadly you lost your companion and vehicle, getting lost in the process and with now only a vague idea on how to get back to the safehouse, where you hope your hidden gear remains untouched.

data.name: Xedra Offworld Team: Jotunn Hunter
data.description: Part of Xedra's Offworld Acquisitions group, you specialized in tracking, killing and retrieving useful components from the cyborg tribes that seem to exist on some of the worlds Xedra had access to.  Do you feel guilt about bringing back the cybernetic components that are now inside you or your teammates?  Or do you worry that now they might be on this world hunting you?  You've lost your sidearm and spent half of your heavy ordnance.  Worst of all, you're out of smokes.

data.name: Xedra Offworld Team: Big Game Hunter
data.description: You are what Xedra refers to as a non-local guide.  A mature Gracken hired on to join the Offworld Acquisitions Team, you trained in human long distance weaponry in order to take down big game and create new improvements to bring back to your people.  They gave you a big gun and a little training in how to use it and in return you help them know what things in other dimensions to hunt and what to run from.

data.name: Xedra Offworld Team: Troll Slayer
data.description: Part of Xedra's Offworld Acquisitions team, you were sent to gather biological specimens, they often objected strenuously to being gathered.  You've got some CBMs in you but understand they probably came out of someone that might have friends.

data.name: Xedra Offworld Team: Specter
data.description: Part of Xedra's Offworld Acquisitions team, you were trained to infiltrate any human compatible cultures that were discovered.  You never found any with technology worth stealing and you aren't sure what that says about humanity.

data.name: Mobile Task Force: Upsilon 4 "Devourers"
data.description: Being part of Upsilon 4, you were always at the front of your unit, protecting other operatives from danger ahead using your eater's abilities.  This one was no different, but something went really wrong.

data.name: Mobile Task Force: Theta 1 "Middle-Management"
data.description: Theta 1, also known as "kindergarten" between other task forces, is used when missions are expected to be too dangerous to send people or when reconnaissance can't obtain any important information about the target, which is why otherworldly creatures, summoned by dreamers, are sent.  It's not the best course of action, but the unit's nearly zero fatality rate makes it worth using.

data.name: Mobile Task Force: Nu 3 "Techno Savvy"
data.description: Despite the "Task Force" in their name, Nu 3 is rarely called into the actual mission; their main task is reconnaissance and developing tools to support another task force, even if these tools last only a few weeks.  But when they do accept a task, it's almost guaranteed to be successful.  It should've been your first day here, but something went really wrong.

data.name: Mobile Task Force: Tau 8 "Anvil"
data.description: Sharing the same problem with Nu 3, dreamsmiths from Tau 8 are not called on the operation very often, and their main work looks really medieval.  Despite this, they are really popular among other branches, as their tools and armor have everything a modern soldier can dream of.
data.//: TODO: add some recipes they could know, if possible

data.name: XEDRA Operative, Department of Extra-Normal Capabilities, SATOR Division
data.description: You joined XEDRA during the years leading up to the Cataclysm, and they told you that you fit the profile of a SATOR agent.  At the time you had no idea what they meant, and they gave you a couple days to process when you learned that magic was real, the enemies of the United States possessed it, and they wanted you to learn it too.  When they sat you down and had you practice writing letters into patterns for days on end you wondered if you had made a mistake, but when one of those squares let you summon a loaf of bread out of thin air for lunch, you changed your tune pretty quickly.

With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the earth, your powers are strengthened by contact with the soil and the rock and weakened by separation from the living earth.

With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the forest, your powers are strengthened by the wild places and weakened within the constructs of humanity.

With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the lakes and rivers, your powers are strengthened when you are surrounded by water and weakened when you spend too long away from the water.

With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the flames, your powers are strengthened when among heat and fire and weakened by the cold.

With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of humanity, your powers are strengthened when among humankind or in the remnants of civilization and weakened when in the wilderness.

With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the winds, your powers are strengthened when under the open sky and weakened when indoors or underground.

In the years and decades leading up to the Cataclysm, things got weirder and weirder.  The government tried their best to cover it up but they couldn't entirely stop all knowledge from leaking out.  You were one of the people who responded to the weirdness by becoming weird yourself; you spent time combing through old books and found some of the charms and spells written in them actually worked.  When you had the right ingredients and were in the right place, you could make the impossible possible.  Maybe lighting a fire without a match won't help you kill a zombie, but it's kept you warm and safe when you're sure other survivors had to shiver as the night closed in.

Perhaps you were the member of a cult, or a strange family legacy, or maybe you just stumbled on a book that probably shouldn't have been left where you could find it.  Regardless, you have the ability to turn into an animal when you kill it and make a talisman out of its bones and skin.  Every change requires a death, but with so much death already since the Cataclysm, what's a little bit more?

data.name: Cryptid Hunter
data.description: You spent months trying to find one of these elusive creatures, searching all over the country in the hopes of proving beyond doubt that they exist.  You recently found enough trustworthy information to write down a map that will certainly lead you to a cryptid.  Now that the supernatural is undeniable you feel that you should find a cryptid anyway, if only to say that you didn't do all this work for nothing.
data.//: This grants a map to a random cryptid and a note with basic info on said cryptid.  Otherwise a version of the park ranger with less gear and without the weapons as they explored far and wide in search of cryptids without having combat training.
data.//2: No camera because their plan is to locate and bring back a cryptid, not take photographies that will be accused of being edited.

data.name: Paradox Survivor
data.description: Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you, but you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.

data.//: This item group gives a random cryptid map and the associated notes when starting as a cryptid hunter.  The probabilities are intended to be equal with each other.

data.description: Working with materials from other dimensions is never easy.  But this definitely improves your ability to work on fabrics and furs from the lands under the hill.
data.//: I don't know if I'll make any advanced proficiencies for changeling recipes but I'd like to at least have some base level ones.

data.description: The art of turning the tears of the moon into weapons and armor, light and impossibly sharp.
You know how you use your mind to transform dreamdross into basic shapes.
Your knowledge has grown, and you know how to shape dreamdross into a weapon of terrible power.
Your knowledge has grown, and you know how to shape dreamdross into an indestructible armor.
Your mind and feeling are the one.  Your items are impossible.  Your dreamdross could be everything.

A fairly disturbing bionic module created by vampires for their servants.  Installed by planting the seed next to the heart inside of the chest, then sealed back up, the remainder of the surgery the seed spreads its root structures across the body and limbs.  The roots large enough to help obstruct damage to the body don't extend into the feet and hands but they do wrap around the skull in places.  They take up very little space for a body plus limbs CBM running mostly along the top layers of the skin.  Rumored to grow denser and thicker as they age over decades and centuries.

Embedded into your back and connected to your bionic power supply is a device to convert the blood of vampires to produce a facsimile of bionic power.  It can store up to 100 mL of blood.  For unknown reasons if installed into an active vampire it will not function when filled with its bearers blood.  No one who talks about it knows why.
Internal tank for vampire blood power generator bionic.
Your vocal cords have been enhanced, able to resonate like a bat to draw in a swarm to protect you.
Your vocal cords have been reinforced and enlarged.  You can make a strange noise with it, but you don't know what it's supposed to communicate.

There are fungi that grow in the corpse dirt that vampires rest in.  In unexposed humans these fungal spores can cause crippling coughing fits and even death.  But when treated with a solution made of vampire blood or harvested straight from the still-warm lungs of a previous recipient they can be migrated into a living host body where they will speed up reactions and increase strength slightly.
Very basic familiarity with various types of alien creatures.
It's particularly difficult to turn daydreams and moonlight into clothing, but you seem to have gotten the hang of it.
Even the Bright Lords would bid on your clothing if they found it at a Goblin Market.
The trees always hearken to your voice and wood practically molds itself like clay in your hands.
Not only can you create furniture and other large constructs using treesinging, you can mold treesung wood into weapons and armor as well.

anything you would consider a leafy green vegetable

Any real, small weapons meant to stab someone at close range; larger shivs basically.
Any real, pole-like weapons designed for bashing and smashing.  Reserved for quality items.
Any real great hammers.  It's got to have a big blunt end on a long pole, directly attached to it.
Any real, top-heavy cutting weapons with a long pole and a blade on the end, designed to swing side-to-side.  Think like a sword with a really long handle.
Any quality weapon designed to hook your opponents and their gear in a fight.  Reserved for the good stuff.
Any weapon that features a long pole with a pointed tip at the end.  Reserved for quality weapons.
Any real, top-heavy bashing weapons with a pointy ball at the end that doesn't independently swing (those are flails).
Any real, edged short swords you could practice with, like broadswords.  I reckon that anything with a straight, sharp point to it that primarily swings side-to-side can qualify.
Any real, edged medium swords you could practice with, like cavalry sabres.  This is any sword that is bigger than a short sword, but shorter than a long sword.
Any real, edged long swords you could practice with, like katanas, longswords, etc.  I reckon that anything with a straight, sharp point to it that primarily swings side-to-side can qualify.

Any real, edged, big swords you could practice with, like zweihanders, greatswords, or the Dragonslayer, etc.  I reckon that anything with a straight, sharp point to it that primarily swings side-to-side, and is large enough to require a normal human to use two hands can qualify.
Any real, quality weapon designed to be used in a thrusting fashion.  Needs to be a sword, not a spear.  This includes fencing weaponry.
Any real, cutting weapons that can be used like an axe; large, heavy head with two sharp sides on a pole.
Any weapon that features a handle and flexible lash.

data.name: Paraclesian Birth
data.description: Your first moments of life.  An elemental fae birth on a dying world.  Now you have to figure out how to survive on your own.  (Select the location that matches your profession or you may have a short journey)  P.S. This scenario is still in development, PRs for additional content welcome.

data.name: Werewolf, Natural-born
data.description: You had no idea what was going on the first time it happened, when you woke up with mud on your bare feet and a sour taste in your mouth, but you were soon found.  The People of the Moon, they called themselves, and they said you were one of them.  A werewolf.  You lived out in the wilderness for a while but didn't entirely abandon human civilization, and when the Cataclysm hit you ignored the evacuation warnings and struck it out on your own.  Maybe some of the People are still out there.

data.name: Once Bitten
data.description: Whether you were visiting Salem's Lot, boating on the Demeter, vacationing to Transylvania, or just another lost boy or girl, you've been bitten by a stranger at twilight the night before.  As a new day breaks you might want to find someone to interview about how you are feeling.  Dark shadows feel more inviting than yesterday and you don't feel like you are long for the day shift.

data.//: Name below is a reference to Isaiah 34:14
data.name: The Owl's Abode
data.description: For most or all of your life, you've had a secret; you are a predator.  While you don't need to drink blood or eat flesh or anything so crude, you must absorb the spiritual essence, the "ruach", of living beings in order to maintain your health and vitality.  You had to hide your condition before the Cataclysm, especially as things became stranger in the years leading up to it, but now you don't have to hide anymore.  On the other hand, your potential ruach supply has taken a drastic decline.

data.name: Challenge - Temporal Misadventure
data.description: During the Cataclysmic portal storms, you and several other people were lost trying to escape the monsters attacking you.  Eventually, something caught up, and as your fellows started turning into frozen statues you ran straight into what should have been open air.  The pain of that impact was nothing compared to the knife you suddenly found stabbed into your torso.  The most you saw of your attacker was a quick blur before everything suddenly changed.  Snow covers the ground, the sun has set, you are freezing cold, and the knife is still stuck in your torso.  However, you've gained a dramatic new sense of time, and what is definitely the beginning of the ability to manipulate it.  Even beyond the knife and the winter you never thought you'd have to prepare for, your new powers tell you that there is much more wrong with you than is immediately apparent.  Hopefully you can use your skills and powers to survive both your new condition and every other horror of the Cataclysm.
Your ability to see the pattern behind a series of data points.  Allows you to ask questions that you otherwise couldn't ask and find things you might have missed otherwise.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You can't even think yourself out of a paper bag.
You get the gist of playing a round of chess.
You realized that one weird tabloid paper you've read a long time ago might have been correct all this time.
You probably know how to deduce an electronic lock's password.
You can easily rule out non-magickal causes in a given situation.
You're aware of more supernatural happenings than everyone else.
You know even what you don't know.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You can't even solve a simple Sudoku puzzle.
You can deduce the whereabouts of your missing item in your house.
You solve murder mysteries in the first chapter.
You can figure out the workings of the world mundane and supernatural from some observations.
You're basically modern day Sherlock Holmes.
No secret is safe from you.
Even the unknowable unknowns are known to you.

data.apply_message: With some effort you can outsmart reality.

Summon a lot of holograms around you, for 0,5 - 1 h.

data.remove_message: Electric clouds are gone.
