data.name: Touch of Frailty
data.description: Like the fading of plantlife in the end of the year, afflict your target with the ravages of age, reducing their physical abilities for a brief period.  The duration is <color_green>greatly increased</color> in autumn.

data.name: Eyes Amid the Leaves
data.description: Gaze at a nearby animal with the eyes of a stalking predator, sending them fleeing.  Repeated gazes in a short period of time have no additional effect.  The glamour has <color_yellow>reduced effect</color> in spring.

data.name: Witch's Warning
data.description: Weaving this glamour will allow you to sense the presence of nearby sorcerers.  The glamour has <color_yellow>reduced duration</color> in spring.
data.message: You mutter a charm under your breath and open your senses up to nearby enchanters.

data.name: Withering Glare
data.description: With a forceful gaze projecting the energies of the dying of the year, you can wither plantlife in moments.  This also applies to mobile or even sapient plants.  The glamour <color_yellow>does less damage</color> in spring.
data.//: Turns out there's already a ter_transform to kill plants so we can just borrow that

description.str: The part of Withering Glare that damages mobile plants.  You shouldn't see it.

data.name: Autumn Mists
data.description: You can draw on the mystery of misty autumn mornings and condense a thick fog out of the air, reducing the vision of everyone and hiding your movements.  Reweave the glamour to dispel it. The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in spring.

data.name: Scarecrow's Mien
data.description: Spin an illusion around yourself, making those who look on you see their greatest fear, increase your ability to intimidate them, though with a corresponding loss of persuasive ability.  The glamour is <color_yellow>less effective</color> in spring.

data.name: Swirl of Autumn Leaves
data.description: Whip up a wind and a swirl of autumn leaves around yourself, giving ranged attacks a chance to go awry.  The glamour also makes you <color_green>harder to spot</color> if used in autumn.
data.message: A spray of colored leaves whirl around you.

data.name: Branches Laden and Heavy
data.description: You can bring a growing plant to full ripeness, allowing you to harvest it immediately.  The glamour <color_red>cannot be used</color> in the spring.

data.name: Balor's Gaze
data.description: It is said that Balor could kill with a glance.  While this glamour is not quite so powerful, you can freeze your target in place, as long as you also take no action but to fix them with your stare.

description.str: Gets Rid of Balor's Gaze on the target.

data.name: Lost in the Mists
data.description: Call up an obscuring mist, rendering anything inside insensate and incapable of navigating or determining their location.  Those inside the fog will wander, blind and deaf, until the glamour fades or they somehow find their way outside of its area.  The affected area is <color_yellow>reduced</color> in the spring.
data.message: With a gesture, a mist begins to rise.

data.description: Your command over plants allows you to cause grass to grow in profusion from the soil, making the terrain very difficult for enemies to traverse.  The glamour is much more difficult to use in the winter.

data.name: Scent of Fresh Flowers
data.description: Cover your own scent with the scent of fresh-blooming flowers, marking it harder for animals (or the dead) to track you.  The glamour's is <color_yellow>less effective</color> in the autumn.
data.message: A pleasant scent fills the air

data.name: Verdant Vitality
data.description: You can draw some of the energy inherent in nearby plants into yourself, restoring a bit of your stamina and easing your pain.  However, the energy is drawn from nearby foliage and cannot be accessed if you are not standing on verdant ground.
data.//: Once terrain can accept flags or timed effects or something, we can use that instead of dead grass.

data.name: Nurturing the Green
data.description: You can greatly speed plant growth.  Grass can grow from seed in moments, crops can shoot towards the sky, and even young trees can put forth mighty limbs.  You cannot, however, bring a plant to ripeness or fruiting.  The glamour <color_red>cannot be used</color> in the winter.

data.name: Spring Cleansing
data.description: Like a house after a long winter, this glamour removes impurities in the target's body, curing them of poison or disease and preventing them from reoccurring while it lasts.  The glamour's duration is <color_yellow>greatly reduced</color> in the autumn.

data.name: War of the Flowers
data.description: Endless fields of daffodil warriors fight and die at the pleasure of their overlords in the battles constantly waging in the Bright Lands.  While this is a simpler glamour that that which creates those armies, you can still spin up a small group of daffodil warriors from some nearby foliage.

data.name: Viridian Cuirass
data.description: Grow a set of enchanted living armor around yourself or an ally, providing protection and resistance to chill temperatures.  The glamour offers <color_yellow>no protection from cold</color> in autumn.

data.name: Ending the Long Slumber
data.description: Like a hibernating animal shaking off the last remnants of sleep when the snow melts, you can shed sleepiness and fatigue.  The glamour requires that you be <color_yellow>outdoors in sunlight</color> if used in autumn.

data.name: Spring Shower
data.description: Cause the sky to cloud over and a soft spring rain to fall.  Reweave the glamour to dispel it.  You cannot summon the rains if the weather is below freezing.

data.name: Gwydion's Wrath
data.description: Summon the wrath of nature upon a single target, causing thorny vines to grow from the ground and attack them mercilessly.  The target must be outside and on natural ground for the glamour to take effect.  The glamour has <color_yellow>reduced duration</color> if used in autumn.

data.//: This is necessary because the valid_targets of the original prevent the spell from being summoned on the ground around it

description.str: The actual summon spell.

data.name: New Growth
data.description: Draw on the power of growth and new sprouts to speed the healing of yourself or one of your allies, as long as you are outside.  The healing rate is <color_yellow>reduced</color> in autumn.

data.name: Ishtar's Folly
data.description: By spinning the energy of desire into a group of human or fae targets, you can fill them with so overpowering a love for you that they will furiously defend you against all threats.  This glamour is <color_yellow>less likely to succeed</color> in the autumn.
data.message: With a whispered hymn, you weave a glamour over your targets.

description.str: Extra buffs for targets affected by Ishtar's Folly.

data.name: Bonefire's Light
data.description: Conjure up a flickering ball of orange and red light that hovers nearby and sheds a dim glow on your surroundings.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in winter.

data.name: Quick-Kindle
data.description: With a quick gesture, summon up a burst of heat sufficient to ignite flammable material.  The glamour <color_red>cannot be used</color> in winter.

data.name: Shading Your Eyes
data.description: The true initiate of summer can gaze directly at the sun without flinching.  The glamour protects your eyes from the light of the noonday sun, as well as other sources of bright light such as flashbangs or welding torches.

data.name: Gift of Warm Blood
data.description: A quick chant infuses the power of summer into your or your ally's blood, providing resistance against hot weather.  The glamour also provides some <color_green>protection against fire</color> in summer.
data.message: A refreshing breeze picks up as you chant.

data.name: Salmon Leap
data.//: TODO: If/when there is a distinction between fast running and jumps, this is a jump.
data.description: Like a salmon leaping over obstacles in a river, you can make prodigious jumps.
data.message: You gather yourself and leap.

data.name: Burning Solar Grasp
data.description: Surround your hands in ethereal flames, doing additional fire damage to targets you strike in melee.  This damage is greater when unarmed, but still transfers to any weapons you wield.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in winter.

data.name: Punishing Summer Heat
data.description: Concentrate the heat of the sun on a small area, inflicting all within with a mystical tiredness that will slow their movements.  In the winter the glamour <color_red>does not work</color> indoors or at night.
data.message: The sunlight shines a little brighter.

data.name: Outracing the Sun
data.description: After using this glamour, begin running.  As long as you continue running, you will not run out of stamina.  Weaving another glamour or attacking breaks the effect.  In the winter the glamour <color_red>does not work</color> if you are indoors.

data.name: Fist of Taranis
data.description: Summon a massive lightning bolt onto a target location.  This glamour may only be used outside during a storm.
data.message: You call down a bolt of thunder!

description.str: The actual spell that casts the Fist of Taranis crater.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
The actual spell that casts the Fist of Taranis crater.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

name.str: Fist of Taranis Monster Start Fire

description.str: The actual spell that Starts a fire at the impact point.  It's a bug if you have it.
The actual spell that casts the Fist of Heaven's Fury shove.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: A Fire in the Blood
data.description: Infuse the energy of the summer sun into your yourself, preparing for battle.  Your stamina will regenerate faster in proportion to the number of adjacent enemies, and you will have an easier time dodging enemy attacks.  In the winter the glamour <color_yellow>is less effective</color>.

data.name: Summer Thunder
data.description: Conjure up a thunderstorm, causing the sky to cloud over, rain to fall, and eventually lightning to flash.  You have no control over the storm once you set it in motion.  This glamour <color_red>will not work</color> if you are indoors or if the temperature is below freezing.

data.name: Ring of Champions
data.description: Summon up a circle of flames around yourself and a nearby enemy, allowing you to fight undisturbed.  You will be immune to the heat of the flames while they last, though stepping into them will end this protection.  The death of the chosen enemy will end the glamour.  You must be <color_yellow>outdoors</color> for this glamour to have any effect.  In the summer, the flames are <color_green>even hotter</color>.  Reweave the glamour to dispel it.

description.str: The spell that creates the actual flames in summer
The spell that creates the actual flames not in summer

data.name: Helios's Wrath
data.description: Blaze with the blinding light of the sun, blinding anyone nearby capable of seeing you.  This is real sunlight and affects creatures harmed by it accordingly.

description.str: Used because auras are not currently possible.  Blind targets are harms those who die in sunlight.
Used because auras are not currently possible.  Causes enemies with the SUNDEATH flag to burn.

data.name: Footsteps in the Snow
data.description: You and your nearby allies' footsteps make almost no sound when you move, like the footsteps of an animal traveling across new-fallen snow.  If used in winter, your footsteps are <color_green>totally silent</color>.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in summer.

data.name: Grip of Winter
data.description: Summon up thick ice around the target's lower limbs, freezing them in place.  Larger targets require more sorcerous might to affect.  If used in winter, the ice covers all of the target's limbs and they also <color_green>cannot attack</color> for the glamour's duration.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in summer.

data.name: Path of Rime
data.description: You can create ice under your feet, allowing you to walk across water or other liquids without sinking into them.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in summer.

data.name: Stillness of the Tomb
data.description: You and your nearby allies' footsteps make almost no sound when you move, like the footsteps of an animal traveling across new-fallen snow.  If used in winter, your footsteps are <color_green>totally silent</color>.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in summer.

data.name: The Rime-Stilled Tongue
data.description: Instill ice into a single target's tongue, rendering it heavy and unwieldy in their mouth, and silence their voice with it.  The affected target will not be able to speak or make any noise at all.  The glamour <color_green>lasts much longer</color> in winter.
data.message: Snow forms around your hand as you gesture at your target.

data.name: Snow-Blindness
data.description: Call up the essence of an endless snow field, shining a moment of brilliant light into your target's eyes and blinding them.  The glamour only works outdoors during the day.  The glamour's duration <color_yellow>is reduced</color> in summer.
data.message: You gesture and your target blinks.

data.name: Jack's Breath
data.description: Draw in the chill air of winter and breathe out a cone of freezing air and ice, damaging and slowing your opponents.
data.message: You breathe out a cone of freezing air.

data.name: The Frozen Heart
data.description: Freeze out all emotion in your heart, rendering you perfectly calm.  This will cancel extremes of both positive and negative emotion and prevent you from feeling anything for the glamour's duration.  This latter effect <color_red>does not occur</color> in summer.

data.name: By Moon or by Starlight
data.//: TODO: Once there is a distinction between total darkness and low light, this glamour should only work in low light
data.description: Become at home in darkness, allowing you to read and perform normal crafting actions as long as there is even a bit of light available.  This glamour <color_yellow>only works outdoors</color> in summer.
data.message: You open your eyes to the dark and the cold.

data.name: Tears of the Cailleach
data.description: Cause a short but furious winter storm in a target location, dropping fist-sized hailstones and ice on your enemies.  The glamour leaves behind a field of ice that makes movement very treacherous.  This ice <color_red>melts immediately</color> in the summer.

name.str: Tears of the Cailleach Bash Damage

description.str: Tears of the Cailleach Bash Damage subcomponent.  Having this spell is a bug.

name.str: Tears of the Cailleach Cold Damage

description.str: Tears of the Cailleach Cold Damage.  Having this spell is a bug.

name.str: Tears of the Cailleach Ice Fields

description.str: Tears of the Cailleach Ice Fields.  Having this spell is a bug.

data.name: The Soul of Iron
data.description: Infuse yourself with the cold and the stasis of iron, cutting off your fey powers.  You will no longer to be able to use any glamours, but can touch iron and steel without penalty.  This glamour's duration is <color_green>extended</color> in winter.
data.message: You feel an dull cold fill your entire body.

data.name: The Long Dark
data.description: Draw on the power of winter to recreate the polar night, blotting out the sun and plunging the nearby area into darkness.  This glamour's duration is <color_yellow>greatly reduced</color> in summer.

data.name: Develop New Glamours
data.description: Using the power of human dreams, unlock the secrets of new seasonal magicks.  It requires a large amount of dreamdross and time to perform this research.

data.name: Extract Dreamsparks
data.description: Pull the power of creativity and enchantment from dreamdross and condense it into dreamsparks, so you can use them to power fae magicks.

data.name: None Here But the Stones
data.description: Disguise yourself within nature, as a rock or tree or part of a babbling brook.  You must be outdoors and on natural terrain for the glamour to take hold, and the glamour <color_red>ends instantly</color> if you move or attack.

data.name: Hidden from Mortal Eyes
data.description: Lord, what fools these mortals be, especially when they cannot see what's right in front of them.  You will be invisible for a time, as long as you do not take hostile action.
data.message: With a laugh and a wink, you disappear.

data.name: Call Wills-o'-the-Wisp
data.description: Summon the ignes fatui to lead your enemies astray.
data.message: At your command, distant lights appear.

data.name: Lights of Imbolc
data.description: Purify yourself or an ally, removing a wide variety of debilitating conditions such as disease or poison.  However, doing so will fatigue the target; too many problems will lead to a long period of recovery afterwards.
data.message: You wave your hand at your target.

data.name: Fires of Bealtaine
data.description: Set a weapon to burn with the purifying light of Bealtaine's bonfires, illuminating your surroundings and causing the weapon to burn anything it strikes.  It does additional damage to creatures of the Nether.  The glamour will not work without a weapon to affect.

description.str: Flames, generated by Fires of Bealtaine.

name.str: Fires of Bealtaine Damage Extra Nether

description.str: Flames, generated by Fires of Bealtaine.  This does extra damage to Nether beings.

data.name: Deeds of Lughnasadh
data.description: Enhance yourself or an ally with the athleticism and prowess of the dancers, runners, and hurlers of Lughnasadh.  This increases movement and attack speed, dodging ability, and allows the target to leap to a rooftop from a standing start.

data.name: Hosts of Samhain
data.description: Summon the hosts of Samhain, the spirits of the victorious dead, to defeat your enemies.  The hosts of Samhain are mighty in battle but cannot abide the light of the sun.
data.message: As you gesture, shadowy figures appear around your target.

data.name: Sovereign's Command
data.description: With a stern word of command, you can glamour one of the common fae, the redcaps or brownies or pooka or bannermen, into defending you from your enemies.
data.message: You snap out an order to your target.

data.name: Come Away, O Human Child
data.description: With a stern word of command or a whispered entreaty, you can glamour a human into defending you from your enemies.
data.message: You cast your glamour over your target.

data.name: Slip Through the Cracks
data.description: When in danger of being discovered, brownies can slip away in moments.  This glamour allows you to vanish and reappear elsewhere in the house.  It cannot be used outdoors.

data.name: Hurry Home
data.description: You always know your home and can return to it at need.  When standing in a doorway, you can use this glamour to return to the last place you slept, as long as you spent at least a day at that place previously and as long as you are unobserved.

data.name: Friend to Birds and Beasts
data.description: You have learned to speak the secret tongues of birds and beasts and may use it to ask them for aid.  Casting this spell on a mammal or a bird will ally them with you, causing them to defend you against your enemies.
data.message: You whisper a few words in the language of beasts.

data.name: Beguilement
data.description: With a wink and a bit of fae glamour, you can enchant a target to defend you for a brief time.  This glamour only <color_yellow>only works</color> on humans.
data.message: You cast your glamour over your target.

data.name: Cloak of Fog
data.description: Call a thick fog from the surrounding air, breaking line of sight with your enemies and obscuring your presence.  Weave the glamour again to dispel it.
data.message: Thick fog billows up around you.

data.name: Chant of Obscuring Mists
data.description: Manipulate the weather, pulling the water from the air and cause a thick fog to form and blanket the countryside.  Weave the glamour again to dispel it.

data.name: Aria of the Droplets
data.description: Manipulate the weather, causing the sky to cloud over and rain to fall.  Weave the glamour again to dispel it.  You cannot control the weather if the temperature is too cold.

data.name: Canticle of Rainstorms
data.description: Manipulate the weather, causing the sky to cloud over and heavy rains to fall.  Weave the glamour again to dispel it.  You cannot control the weather if the temperature is too cold.

data.name: Symphony of Levin
data.description: Manipulate the weather, transforming a rainstorm into a violent lightning storm.  It must already be raining heavily to transform the weather into a lightning storm, and a lightning storm cannot be controlled after the glamour is woven.

data.name: The One Who Knocks
data.description: Make a distant knocking sound, leading others astray.
data.message: A loud thump resounds.

data.name: Cultivate Goblin Fruit
data.description: You may spin a bit of fae magic into water, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast near water or under the rain.

data.name: Cultivate Goblin Fruit
data.description: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the air, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast indoors, when nobody is watching.

data.name: Cultivate Goblin Fruit
data.description: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the air, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast near an animal.

data.name: Cultivate Goblin Fruit
data.description: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the earth, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast underground or at night.

data.name: Cultivate Goblin Fruit
data.description: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the air, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast near a human or a Fae.

data.name: Time Freeze
data.description: Freeze your target in time, preventing them from acting but also preventing them from suffering harm.
data.message: You freeze your target in time!

data.name: Normalize Time
data.description: Fix the target area's timestream, unfreezing frozen targets and ending any active timeloops.

data.name: Unfreeze Time - Loop
data.description: Remove a time loop.  Part of the main unfreeze spell.  Having this spell is a bug.

data.name: Unfreeze Time - Terrain
data.description: Unfreeze terrain from frozen time.  Part of the main unfreeze spell.  Having this spell is a bug.

data.name: Entropic Burst
data.description: Dangerously destabilize local time in an area, flooding everything within with entropy.  This will destroy any areas of frozen time and steadily erode any creatures caught within.

data.name: Entropic Burst - Fields
data.description: Remove fields of frozen time.  Part of the Entropic Burst spell.  Having this spell is a bug.

data.name: Entropic Burst - Effect
data.description: Unfreeze target from frozen time.  Part of the main entropic burst spell.  Having this spell is a bug.

data.name: Time Bubble
data.description: Create an impenetrable bubble of frozen time at your chosen location, freezing everything within.
data.message: You create a bubble of frozen time!

data.name: Revert Wound
data.description: Rewind the last injury you have taken, erasing the effects it has had on your person.

data.name: Time Loop
data.description: Loop time around your person for a short duration, repeatedly resetting any changes to your person every few seconds.

data.name: Time Stop
data.description: Temporarily halt the progression of time for everything but yourself.  Lasts roughly 2 seconds per level.

data.name: Revert Location
data.description: Revert yourself to a location you have previously memorized.

data.name: Memorize Location
data.description: Spend time memorizing an area so you can revert your physical location to that spot.

data.name: Cement Time
data.description: Stabilize a zone of disjointed time, preventing it from decaying.

data.name: Cement Time - Target
data.description: Stabilize target of frozen time.  Part of the main cement spell.  Having this spell is a bug.

data.name: Paradox
data.description: Create a minute incision in your target's personal timestream, separating their present from their past and thus deleting them from reality in a temporal paradox.  This technique is harder to perform on more powerful foes, and may result in backlash if you are not prepared.  Luckily, this time anomaly is significant enough that merely observing it will give you significant temporal insights based on its strength.

description.str: Banish Portion of Paradox.  Having this spell is a bug

data.name: Stable Time Loop (T)
data.description: Create a long-lasting time loop around yourself which you can end at any time.  Ending the loop will return you to the state you were in at the start of it.

data.name: Chronal Acceleration (T)
data.description: You speed up the flow of your personal timestream, allowing you to act quicker relative to everything else.  This power will remain active until toggled off.

data.name: Destabilizing Strikes (T)
data.description: By maintaining a field of destabilized time around your body, you can effortlessly cause your attacks to erode your target over time.  This power will remain active until toggled off.

data.name: Destabilizing Strikes (T) - Attack
data.description: This causes the dot when attacking targets with the destabilizing strikes buff.  Having the spell is a bug.

data.name: Stabilize Timeline (T)
data.description: Stabilize your personal timeline, making yourself immune to adverse changes to time around you.  This power will remain active until toggled off.

data.name: Reverse Entropy (T)
data.description: Reverse the entropy on your equipment, repairing any damage it has taken or energy it has spent over time.  This power will remain active until toggled off.

data.name: Rewrite Wound Causality (M)
data.description: Sink into a mediative trance where you steadily rewrite the causality of your current wounds, effectively healing yourself of injury.  This power will remain active until you run out of mana or your wounds are healed.

data.name: Rewrite Equipment Causality (M)
data.description: Sink into a mediative trance where you steadily rewrite the causality of your carried items, efficiently repairing any faults they may have.  This power will remain active until you run out of mana or your wounds are healed.

data.name: Night Sight
data.description: Gives you the power to see in the dark.
data.message: Your eyes glow lavender for a moment.  Now your sight can pierce the darkest shadows.

data.name: Weight of Dread
data.description: Everything around you faces an existential crisis and moves slower as a result.  Including things that you wouldn't expect to suffer from existential crises, like the undead.  The air around the targets' extremities chills dramatically.  Higher levels allow a bigger AoE, and longer effect.

data.name: Blur
data.description: The edges of your form seem to blur and distort, increasing the amount of attacks you might dodge in a given turn.

data.name: Damage Transfer
data.description: Allows you to move some damage from your body to someone else.  Usually people don't like it, but who cares now?
data.//: deal damage, give heal. nothing special.

description.str: A spell that will heal you for a bit.  You can see it only in debug mode.

data.name: Pyroportation
data.description: Transports you from one place to another, creating a huge fire explosion in the end.

description.str: Makes a pretty big fire explosion around you.

data.name: Call Daffodil
data.description: A few daffodil warriors appear near you.  They will fight for you, but they will fade away after a day.

description.str: Hidden spell that spawns the daffodil
Intended to be hidden.  This is how Boann teleport away monsters that hit her.
Intended to be hidden.  Makes Boann teleport the player away, spawns some huntsmen and hounds then cure all her ailments and injuries if she survives being hit by the player.
Will heal injuries all over Boann's body.
Boann's about to retaliate against monsters, deleting them as they are "teleported" away.  You shouldn't see this
Boann's retaliation against monsters, deleting them as they are "teleported" away.  You shouldn't see this
Banish the caster, killing them and destroying their body.  Having this spell is a bug, and casting it would be suicidal.

data.name: Return Critters
data.description: Summons your critters back to you, if they got lost.

data.name: Dream Blade
data.description: This ephemeral blade allows you to defend yourself with dreams brought out of your mind!

data.name: Dream Dagger
data.description: This ephemeral dagger is powered with your own inner reality connections, and is deadlier the larger your mana pool.

data.name: Dream Armor
data.description: Armor that sits lightly on your body with little in the way of encumbrance and rests on top of whatever you are wearing.

data.name: Bring Forth Dreamdross
data.description: This ritual pulls a small amount of dreamdross into our world and makes it permanent.  These scraps of dreaming can then be used to make permanent objects.
Attempts to banish things clearly inimical to local physics back to their home dimension.
Attempts to banish monsters crafted from the darkest of nights.

data.name: Twin
data.description: Make a fake copy of yourself to disrupt your enemies.

data.name: Twin Flood
data.description: Fill the reality with your own copies.

data.name: Unfold
data.description: All walls are obliterated before your eyes.

data.name: Spatial Awareness
data.description: Feel them.  See them.  Connect to them.

data.name: Summon Shifter
data.description: Summon a portal creature to help in a dangerous situation.

data.name: Summon Light
data.description: Summon a disturbed sapient entity of another reality with a hatred for living creatures.  It won't attack you.  At least for now.

data.name: Hammering
data.description: Using your energy you construct an oddly shaped hammer.  You can use it to smash your enemies, or breach different obstacles.

description.str: Deal some damage.  You can't see it except in debug mode.
Removes constructed hammer.  You can't see it except in debug mode.

data.name: Summon Duplicator
data.description: Summon a portal creature to help in a dangerous situation.

data.name: Summon Time Bubble
data.description: Summon an impenetrable bubble of frozen time at your chosen location, freezing everything within.
data.message: You create a bubble of frozen time!

data.name: Toss a Coin
data.description: Toss a coin.  On which side are you?

data.name: Summon Angel
data.description: Summon a creature that looks pretty similar to how angels are described in the Bible - a giant flying mess of wings, eyes and rings.

data.name: Construct a Winch
data.description: Create a small token.  When used, it'll pull you back to the place you created it.

description.str: Spawns a winch item.  You can see it only in debug mode.

data.name: Pull From Beyond
data.description: Using your abilities, you compress the gap between your hands with pure energy, attempting to construct…  something.

data.name: Generate Accelerated Time
data.description: Continuously generate short-lived bubbles of accelerated time around you, allowing you and anything else that enters to act far quicker than normal.

data.name: Ethereal Wings
data.description: Two ethereal wings sprout out of your back indefinitely until toggled off.  They work as phantasmal pair of wings that can somehow lift your weight even without conscious effort.

data.name: Karma Arms
data.description: Four transparent arms emit out of your body indefinitely until toggled off.  They work as a desirable additional pair of arms, and who knows what power they contain?
data.//: obvious reference for 'Submachine' by Mateusz Skutnik, albeit no portals; maybe should actually make it a single arm, that can draw portals.

data.name: Stalker's Oculars
data.description: Your own eyes are replaced with the eyeballs of an unknown creature, indefinitely, until you toggle them off.  Compounded from billions of red crosses inside void-dark sclera, they can see much more clearly than any natural creature.

data.name: Devil's Tail
data.description: A stretchy tail appears from the base of your spine, instinctively aiding you in battle or moving to defend you, indefinitely, until toggled off.

data.name: Lucid Dreams
data.description: The line between reality and your dreams shrinks enormously.  In this dream you are barely affected by reality, with most changes to your body reverting when you wake up.  While it may end your dream, not even death can touch you.

data.name: Call Oneiric Hammer
data.description: Creates a crystal blacksmith's hammer with which to build a new reality.  You need all your magic force to hold it, and you are unable to do any magic while using it.

data.name: Eat dreamdross
data.description: You consume dreamdross to regain mana.  Pretty tasty.

description.str: Boost your mood from consuming dreamdross.  Tier 1 effect.

data.name: Eat more dreamdross
data.description: You can consume more dreamdross to regain mana in one sitting.  Delicious.

description.str: Boost your mood from consuming dreamdross.  Tier 2 effect.

data.name: Eat dreamdross ingots
data.description: You can't really process so much dreamdross at once, and additionally to restoring your mana pool, it directly improves your body, making your stronger and healthier.  It is probably the most delicious thing in your life.

description.str: Boost your mood from consuming dreamdross.  Tier 3 effect.
Restore some mana when you consume a whole dreamdross ingot.

data.name: Blood Boil
data.description: With a shouted ancient word, the target's blood temperature begins to increase dangerously.

data.name: Trade dreams for health
data.description: Absorbs some dross and heals damage to yourself.

data.name: Recover fatigue for dreams
data.description: Absorbs some dross and heals fatigue to yourself.
data.message: You feel refreshed.

data.name: Spring-heeled Leap
data.description: Force pushes your feet off the ground and launches you several meters.

data.name: Blind Rage
data.description: Perfect hatred.

data.name: Circulatory
data.description: Don't stop.

data.name: Dark Vision
data.description: Enhance your eyes to see at night as clearly as in daylight.

data.name: Dodge
data.description: Shun their attacks.

data.name: Endurance
data.description: Take the blows.  Don't let the world kill you.

data.name: Hide
data.description: Don't let them spot you.

data.name: Open Mind
data.description: Close your eyes and see.

data.name: Physical Instrument
data.description: Your body is a tool of destruction.  Use it effectively.

data.name: Pierce
data.description: Throw a long ethereal spear out of your hand.

data.name: Rush
data.description: Run.  Run as fast as you can.  Don't stop.

data.name: Weakening
data.description: Make enemies around you more vulnerable.

data.name: Unbreakable
data.description: Nothing can move you from your path.

data.name: Stabilize in Reality
data.description: Prevent hostile adjustments to your personal reality and timeline.

data.name: Erosion
data.description: Generate an unstable field of time close to your body that erodes creatures you attack in melee over time.

data.name: Erosion - Attack
data.description: This causes the dot when attacking targets with the erosion buff.  Having the spell is a bug.

data.name: Point Blank
data.description: A straight hit with your arm.  Using additional energy you could probably break a wall with such a powerful strike.

data.name: To Keep Off the Rain and the Damp
data.description: Keep yourself from getting wet in the rain.  The charm will not keep you dry if you step into a water source.
data.message: You crush the leaves and wrap them in the cloth, touching it to you forehead, the crown of your head, both shoulders, and the backs of both wrists as you recite the words of the charm.

data.name: To Bring Light to Dark Places
data.description: Summon up a bobbing ball of light, just bright enough to read by.  You may activate the witchlight to dismiss it.
data.message: Takin a bit of oil on your fingertips, you trace a pattern in the air while reciting the words of the charm, and a glowing ball of light forms in the air.

data.name: To Bring Health to the Soil and Life to the Crops
data.description: While standing on soil or turned earth, perform a ritual to increase the bounty of the crops.  The casting of this charm must end within one hour of noon.
data.message: You dance slowly over the living earth, letting the seeds fall at the appropriate time, and as the sun climbs to its zenith you recite the last words of the charm.

data.name: To Kindle the Flames
data.description: Call forth the remnants of a fire from some ash to light a new flame.
data.message: You sprinkle the wood ash over the kindling as you recite the words of the charm.

data.name: To Spot the Goodly Folk
data.description: Using wild herbs and hawthorn berries, create an amulet that will tell you if any of the Fair Folk are nearby.
data.message: You laboriously sew the square of leather into a pouch and place the herbs and hawthorn berries inside.  Chanting softly, you seal the bag and attach the string to it so it can be worn around your neck.

data.name: To Perceive the Mazzikin
data.description: Using blood and ashes and certain herbs, create a paste that when rubbed on the eyes, will allow you to perceive otherworldly beings even in darkness or through walls.  It will inhibit your mundane sight, however.
data.message: You grind the bones to powder and mix in the blood and herbs while rhythmically chanting the words of the charm, and when you're done you have a dark, foul-smelling paste as the reward of your labors.

data.name: Maze the Little Folk
data.description: A spell to create a snare for catching one of the little folk, a changeling.  Has no effect on the elder spirits of wood and water, fire and earth, nor plant or man.
data.message: You skein a complicated cat's cradle with splinters of wood guiding the way in to blackberries at each of the focus points in your design.

data.name: To Befuddle As the Thunderstrike
data.description: While outdoors, recite a quick charm to produce a flash of light like unto a thunderbolt, bedazzling anyone around you.
data.message: You call out the words of the charm to the sky and there is a burst of light.

name.str: To Befuddle As the Thunderstrike Real

description.str: The actual spell that causes the effect.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: To Purge the Most Virulent Grippe
data.description: By adding particular herbs and a bit of iron to your tea while you recite the words of the charm over it, you can brew a tea that will prove a sovereign remedy to a cold or a flu.
data.message: You brew the tea, adding in a bit of scrap iron and herbs to mix in, while you recite a chant as you stir, and eventually the tea is ready.

data.name: To Ward Off the Evil Eye
data.description: With a bit of salt and some muttered words, deflect the gaze of the evil eye.
data.message: You toss a bit of salt over your left shoulder with your right hand and spit three times into the folds of your clothing as you say, "Keneinahora".

data.name: To Thrice-Bar the Portal
data.description: With some string and the words of the charm, lock a door firmly, even one that doesn't have a locking mechanism.
data.message: You wind the cord several times around your fingers, muttering the words of the charm, and as the pattern ends you hear a soft thud.

data.name: The Coin of Gad
data.description: With a candle, a penny, and paper, this will create a short lived luck charm upon oneself.
data.message: You write the words upon the paper, place the penny on the ground, place the paper upon the penny, light the candle then the paper and firmly place the candle in the ashes on top of the penny, let the candle burn down melting all over the penny.  You will find your steps slightly lucky for the several hours to potentially a full day.

data.name: To See Beyond the Barriers
data.description: Gain a brief vision of what lies beyond a wall or a doorway.
data.message: You close your eyes and place the shards of glass over them and press, just slightly.  As the pain blooms and the blood trickles, you see beyond.

name.str: To See Beyond the Barriers Real

description.str: The actual spell that causes the effect for To See Beyond the Barriers.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: To Sooth the Pains and Injuries of the Flesh
data.description: Mix a paste of herbs, water, and willow bark and rub it on the target's wounds.  The charm increases the speed at which wounds heal, as long as the target does not engage in any strenuous activity.
data.message: You grind the herbs and willowbark together with the water, making a thick, woody-smelling paste, and rub it on the target.

data.name: To Halt the Scarlet Flow
data.description: With some whispered words and a mixture of iron, salt, and herbs, increase your ability to stop the flow of blood.  Best recited right before bandaging a wound.
data.message: You face toward the east and recite the words of the charm as you rub the iron and salt and herbs on your hands.

data.name: To Vanish Amidst the Leaves
data.description: While standing in a forest, conceal your presence.  For a brief time after using the charm, anything looking at you will only see another bit of foliage.  Movement or taking any hostile action will cancel the charm.
data.message: You wrap the beans in the leaf and, with a slight grimace, recite the words of the charm before you put them in your mouth and hold them there.

data.name: To Sail on the River of Dreams
data.description: With lavender and thyme, weave a barrier around your sleeping space to keep bad dreams away.  You must perform the charm directly before trying to sleep; moving will breach the barrier and allow the nightmares to find a way in again.
data.message: You place the herbs under your pillow and, while chanting the words of the charm, paint some thyme oil on the four corners of your sleeping space.

data.name: To Walk the Forests with the Brown One
data.description: Over the freshly-slain and butchered corpse of a bear, recite a paean to its spirit while using its fur and sinew and skull to create a garment.  Putting the garment on will take the spirit of the bear into yourself, allowing you to assume its form until the garment is removed.
data.message: As you recite the words of the charm, you sew the bits of fur together into a rough mantle with the bear skull at the top.

data.name: To Walk Across the Flowing Waters
data.description: While standing with your feet in the water, recite this charm to have the water bear you up.  You must keep moving at a steady pace, without running or stopping for more than a few moments, or the charm will fade.

data.name: To Bless the Sacred Weapon
data.description: Ensorcell an iron or steel weapon that you are holding so it does additional damage to unholy creatures when used in melee combat.  If the weapon is too damaged, the charm will cease to function.

description.str: This is the extra damage a blessed weapon does to Nether creatures.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: To Project the Etheric Form
data.description: After a period of trance and meditation, send out your disembodied spirit to wander the world.  Use of this ritual is <color_yellow>very tiring</color> and you will become increasingly more weary the longer you remain out of your body.
data.message: You settle down and slip into a trance.

data.name: To Shield the Mind from Assault
data.description: The first principle of psychic self-defense is to make sure your mind is in proper order so there is no foothold an assault can take advantage of.  While in effect, your mind is protected against psychic attack.  <color_red>Too much pain</color> will disrupt your concentration.
data.message: You settle down and begin ordering your mind.

data.name: Follow the Silver Cord
data.description: Follow the silver cord back to your body.

data.name: To Walk Upon the Water
data.description: Create a magic square that can later be used in a short ritual to walk across the surface of the water.
data.message: Focusing your mind and muttering the charms and spells under your breath, you carefully write down the patterns of the magic square.

data.name: To Operate Under the Water
data.description: Create a magic square that can later be used in a short ritual to breathe underwater.
data.message: Focusing your mind and muttering the charms and spells under your breath, you carefully write down the patterns of the magic square.

data.name: To Demolish Buildings and Strongholds
data.description: Create a magic square that can later be used in a short ritual to do massive damage to a nearby structure.
data.message: Focusing your mind and muttering the charms and spells under your breath, you carefully write down the patterns of the magic square.

name.str: To Demolish Buildings and Strongholds Real

description.str: The actual spell for To Demolish Buildings and Strongholds.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: To Cause Armed Men to Appear
data.description: Create a magic square to summon an ethereal group of soldiers who will attack your enemies.
data.message: Focusing your mind and muttering the charms and spells under your breath, you carefully write down the patterns of the magic square.

data.name: To Cause the Spirits to Bring us Anything We May Wish to Eat or to Drink
data.description: Create a magic square to cause an ethereal spirit to bring wine, meat, cheese, or bread to you.
data.message: Focusing your mind and muttering the charms and spells under your breath, you carefully write down the patterns of the magic square.

data.name: To Render Oneself Invisible Unto Every Person
data.description: Create a magic square to that will cause you to turn completely invisible.  Violent action will reveal your presence.
data.message: Focusing your mind and muttering the charms and spells under your breath, you carefully write down the patterns of the magic square.

description.str: Deal some damage to the pushed enemy.

You play and sing songs written by or about a Finnish wizard/deity.  It summons forest mammals to your presence.

data.message: The sandwich is a flavor beyond time and space, and as you lick your fingers clean you feel your youth return to you - Wait, no, Your wounds are just healing.

data.message: The location the grenade occupied is instantly overwhelmed with sounds and colors you've never felt before as space warps in impossible ways.  Whatever used to be there is now gone.

description.str: Having this spell is a bug.  Has a 50% chance to spawn a reality tear
Having this spell is a bug.  Will remove tears in reality and other portals with side effects.

data.message: The two halves of the smoother surge together, forcing the teleporters together with a massive clang!  Due to your precise engineering the teleporters activate at the exact moment of impact, temporarily shunting them into the nether and unleashing a massive cascade of netherium energy that ripples around you.

description.str: Having this spell is a bug.  Causes a strong portal storm.

data.name: Inventor Time Pierce
data.description: Used by a time piercer to fix frozen time areas.  Having this spell is a bug.

data.name: Inventor Time Pierce - Creature
data.description: Used by a time piercer to fix time frozen creatures.  Having this spell is a bug.

data.name: Time Freeze
data.description: Freezes the target in time.  Having this spell is a bug.

data.name: Time Freeze - Spawn Trap
data.description: Spawns the trap after it is used.  Having this spell is a bug.

description.str: Targets you hit are blinded.
Produces the fruit's flash effect when eaten.  You're not supposed to see this, the same way your foes aren't supposed to see after you ate that fruit near them.
Cast heat beams in random directions.

data.message: Fiery needles emerge from your body and surge towards anything vaguely hostile.

description.str: Uncontrolled heat blast.
Reveal map when you eat a goblin fruit.  You must not see this.

data.name: Essence Drain
data.description: Touch your victim and drain away a part of their ruach to fuel you.  It only works on living creatures, and animals provide barely any ruach compared to humans.

data.//: You should only ever know one of these two at a time
data.name: Ruach Drinker
data.description: Drain the ruach from a target at range.  It only works on living creatures, and animals provide barely any ruach compared to humans.

data.name: Ruach Drinker
data.description: Drain the ruach from a target at range.  It only works on living creatures, and animals provide barely any ruach compared to humans.

data.name: The Evil Eye
data.description: Curse a single nearby target with misfortune.

data.name: Cry of the Night-bird
data.description: Let out a piercing cry, disorienting all nearby enemies and allies.  Of necessity, this is a very loud course of action.

description.str: The actual Cry of the Night-bird that applies the effect.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: Dwelling in Deep Darkness
data.description: Cut a single target off from the light.  It works only at night, and only either indoors or outside away from the cities.
data.//: Logic for the restrictions is that lilit are supposd to be found in the wilderness or in abandoned buildings

data.name: Senseless and Without Knowledge
data.description: Beguile a single human, fey, or avian target, causing them to stand in a stupor or wander aimlessly.  Any damage taken will break the effect.

data.name: Unleash the Night-Wind
data.description: Summon a miasma filled with pestilence to infect your enemies.  This supernatural disease can even strike zombies or stranger creatures.

data.name: Devoured by Pestilence
data.description: Enhance the power of the miasma from Unleash the Night-Wind, doing serious damage and crippling your target.

data.name: Neither Sleep Nor Slumber
data.description: Spend ruach to alleviate your sleepiness.

data.name: Thick Clouds A Covering
data.description: Manipulate the weather, pulling the water from the air and cause a thick fog to form and blanket the countryside.  Activate again to release your hold on the weather.

data.name: Reaping the Whirlwind
data.description: Spend some ruach to greatly enhance your speed for a short period of time.

data.name: Strix Leap
data.description: You squat down, build up tension in your legs, then with a mighty beat of your wings, you leap.

data.name: The Moon to Rule the Night
data.description: At night under the moon, you can greatly speed your healing, knitting together grievous wounds in moments.  This requires direct moonlight; clouds, rain, or being indoors will prevent this power from working.

description.str: This reduces pain for shapeshifters as their wounds regenerate.  You should never see it.

data.name: Scent of Blood
data.description:
You can smell even the faintest traces of living human, or nearly-human, blood.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 0 ml.

data.name: Drink Blood
data.description: Your fangs allow you to drink blood from an incapacitated or sleeping target.

data.name: Unholy Endurance
data.description:
You focus on sending the blood in your veins to where it can do the most good for your immediate stamina.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 100 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

data.name: Learn from the Children of the Night
data.description:
Speak to nearby night-creatures; rats, bats, wolves, and so on.  They will tell you the layout of your surrounding area.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 100 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

data.name: Blood-Fueled Magic
data.description:
You consume some of the blood in your veins, turning it into magical power.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 200 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

data.name: Sanguine Restoration
data.description:
Heal your wounds with the power of stolen blood.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 750 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

With a bit of stolen blood and a savage expression, you can send your enemies fleeing.  This power only works on enemies capable of feeling fear.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 150 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

data.name: Hypnotic Gaze
data.description:
Stare into the eyes of your victim and wills them to pause.  This power does not work on unliving targets.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 150 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

data.name: Cowing the Beast
data.description:
Exert command over a predatory wild animal like a wolf or a rat, making it your ally for a time.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 500 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

description.str: The actual power that lets you command a beast.  If you see this, it's a bug.

data.name: Earthen Slumber
data.description:
You can sleep within the earth itself, avoiding the hateful light of the sun.  This power must be used on diggable soil.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 0 ml.

data.name: Torpor
data.description: Enter a deathlike slumber and recover from your wounds and fatigue.  Preferably while somewhere nobody could attack you while you sleep.
data.message: You enter torpor.

data.name: Dominating Gaze
data.description:
Take control of a mind.  Only works on targets that have weak minds.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 700 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).
data.message: You look for a mind to control.

description.str: The actual power that lets you take over a mind.  If you see this, it's a bug.

data.name: Create blood-storing sphere.
data.description: Create a magical sphere that will contain any blood you will put in it until the spell ends.
data.message: You conjure a magical sphere to store blood.

data.name: Shrouded by the Shadowed Path.
data.description:
Surround yourself in shadows, becoming invisible for a while.  This power will fail if you stand outside under the sun.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 300 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).
